expertise_en: Natural farming; locally adapted seed; low-input agriculture
expertise_zh: 自然農法；在地適應種子；低投入農業
summary_en: [2026] Invited speaker at the team's 5 September forum. He argued that excessive technological intervention treats symptoms rather than causes, likening it to over-prescribing painkillers, and used the example of Zambia to show how external support and high-yield seed can reduce farmers' independence. He encouraged the team to create an environment in which plants develop their own resilience rather than intervening directly.
summary_zh: [2026] 9 月 5 日團隊論壇的受邀講者。他認為過度的科技介入只治標不治本，並以醫師動輒開止痛藥為比喻；也以尚比亞為例，說明外來援助與高產種子可能削弱農民的自主性。他鼓勵團隊營造讓植物自行發展韌性的環境，而不是直接介入。
impact_en: [2026] Reinforced, with Ms. Chen, Prof. Huang and the other speakers, the design commitment that ReLeaf acts only on forecast stress, periodically, and at a validated dose.
impact_zh: [2026] 與陳惠雯老師、黃院長及其他講者的意見一起，強化了 ReLeaf「只在預測到逆境時、週期性、以驗證劑量作用」的設計承諾。

expertise_en: Plant and stress biology; PGPR; biosecurity
expertise_zh: 植物與逆境生物學；植物生長促進根圈細菌（PGPR）；生物安全
summary_en: [2026] The team's first expert interview, held online while the plant model and stress method were still open. The team asked about Medicago truncatula, PGPR, planting, plant stress and biosecurity. She suggested measuring what PGPR does to germination speed and early growth against untreated seedlings, simulating salinity by watering only every few days, and simulating drought with particles that block water uptake.
summary_zh: [2026] 團隊第一場專家訪談，於線上進行，當時植物模型與逆境方法都還沒定案。團隊請教了蒺藜苜蓿（Medicago truncatula）、PGPR、栽培、植物逆境與生物安全等問題。她建議比較有無 PGPR 處理的發芽速度與早期生長，以每隔幾天才澆水來模擬鹽害，並用阻擋植物吸水的顆粒來模擬乾旱。
impact_en: [2026] Put both the Medicago target plant and the genetic kill switch in doubt; the team began considering a different plant, hydroponics and seedling-stage testing, and later moved biosafety onto physical containment.
impact_zh: [2026] 讓團隊開始質疑以苜蓿為目標植物及基因自殺開關的設計；之後轉向考慮更換植物、水耕與幼苗期測試，並把生物安全改由物理圍堵承擔。

expertise_en: Deployment and human practices (per the IHP pipeline tag)
expertise_zh: 部署與人類實踐（依 IHP 分類）
summary_en: [2026] A meeting on 31 August listed in the IHP pipelines under Deployment & Human Practices. The wiki states that the notes from this meeting are still being written up.
summary_zh: [2026] 8 月 31 日的一場會議，列於 IHP 的「部署與人類實踐」分類。wiki 註明此次會議紀錄仍在整理中。

name_en: 2nd International Symposium on Living Systems Design Research
name_zh: 第二屆國際生命系統設計研究研討會（國立中興大學）
organisation_en: 2nd International Symposium on Living Systems Design Research
organisation_zh: 第二屆國際生命系統設計研究研討會（國立中興大學）
unit_en: Co-hosted by NCHU and the Japanese Society for Living Systems Design Research
expertise_en: Host-microbe-molecule communication; living systems design
expertise_zh: 宿主、微生物與分子間的溝通；生命系統設計
summary_en: [2026] At Dean Huang's invitation, the team presented a poster on 11 September at the symposium held at NCHU from 10 to 13 September. Professors said the team needs a deeper understanding of its experimental data and the ACC deaminase mechanism, told them to put the finding in every slide title (e.g. '0.5 mM ACCD increases growth by 5 mm at 12 mM NaCl stress for 1 week') and to open with the farmers' problem.
summary_zh: [2026] 應黃介辰院長邀請，團隊於 9 月 11 日在中興大學舉辦的研討會（9 月 10 日至 13 日）發表海報。教授們指出團隊需要更深入理解實驗數據與 ACC 去胺酶機制，建議每張投影片標題直接寫出發現（例如「0.5 mM ACCD 在 12 mM NaCl 逆境一週下使生長增加 5 mm」），並以農民的問題作為開場。
impact_en: [2026] Slide titles now state findings, graphs are shown only when the presenter can explain all of them, a step-by-step ACCD mechanism explanation was prepared, and the narrative became more problem-driven and farmer-first.
impact_zh: [2026] 投影片標題改為陳述發現；只有講者能完整解釋的圖表才上投影片；準備 ACCD 機制的逐步說明；敘事改為以問題與農民需求為先。

unit_en: Institute of Plant and Microbial Biology
unit_zh: 植物暨微生物學研究所
expertise_en: Plant drought stress; proline metabolism; stress physiology
expertise_zh: 植物乾旱逆境；脯胺酸代謝；逆境生理
summary_en: [2026] The team visited his lab at Academia Sinica (the interview log dates it 3 April, the plant page 4 April) to discuss drought mechanisms and the proline delivery idea, and saw his growth chamber full of vertical plates. He advised optimising proline dose, checking that bacterial products leave the plant's proline-redox cycle alone, testing stress priming, measuring root growth and biomass, and prioritising early stress detection over recovery.
summary_zh: [2026] 團隊前往中研院拜訪他的實驗室（訪談紀錄記為 4 月 3 日，植物頁記為 4 月 4 日），討論乾旱機制與脯胺酸遞送構想，並參觀了擺滿垂直培養盤的生長箱。他建議優化脯胺酸劑量、確認細菌產物不干擾植物本身的脯胺酸氧化還原循環、嘗試逆境預處理（priming）、量測根長與生物量，並以及早偵測逆境優先於事後恢復。
impact_en: [2026] The protectant concept shifted from supplying compounds toward working with the plant's own drought response. The team's vertical plate rack and humidity box were copied from what they saw there, and the gradual soil salinity ramp run in August was his proposal (later judged too mild by Prof. Cheng).
impact_zh: [2026] 保護劑構想由「直接提供化合物」轉向「調節植物自身的乾旱反應」。團隊的垂直培養架與保濕箱仿自當天所見，8 月的土壤漸進加鹽方案也是他的建議（後來鄭教授認為太溫和）。

name_en: Affiliated Experimental Elementary School of University of Taipei
name_zh: 臺北市立大學附設實驗國民小學
organisation_en: Affiliated Experimental Elementary School of University of Taipei
organisation_zh: 臺北市立大學附設實驗國民小學
expertise_en: Elementary students (grades 4 to 6)
expertise_zh: 國小學生（四至六年級）
summary_en: [2026] Trial 2 of the 'Little Plant Guardians' workshop, with 28 students in the pre-survey and 22 in the post-survey. Students found the English content hard ('too much vocab'), and a teacher asked the team to explain how the self-watering planter relates to the lesson topic.
summary_zh: [2026] 「小小植物守護者」工作坊第 2 次試教，前測 28 人、後測 22 人。學生反映英文內容太難（「單字太多」），老師則請團隊說明自動澆水盆栽與課程主題的關聯。
impact_en: [2026] The team spent more time explaining vocabulary, broke complex words into simpler concepts, and explained the planter's link to automated protectant release before the activity.
impact_zh: [2026] 團隊增加單字講解時間、把複雜詞彙拆成較簡單的概念，並在活動前先說明盆栽與自動釋放保護劑的關聯。

name_en: BIO Asia-Taiwan Exhibition 2026 (exhibitors, experts and researchers)
organisation_en: BIO Asia-Taiwan Exhibition 2026 (exhibitors, experts and researchers)
expertise_en: Biotechnology industry; bioprocess equipment; commercial bioreactors
expertise_zh: 生技產業；生物製程設備；商用生物反應器
summary_en: [2026] The team visited the exhibition and talked to companies, experts and researchers at several booths, including hollow-fibre setups and a commercial reactor with oxygen control. Booths repeatedly told them that B. subtilis survival and protein output depend on dissolved-oxygen monitoring and active aeration or stirring, not passive containment alone, and that stress tolerance depends on how protective molecules are regulated, not only their presence.
summary_zh: [2026] 團隊參觀亞洲生技大展，在多個攤位與廠商、專家與研究人員交流，包括中空纖維裝置與具氧氣控制的商用反應器。多個攤位都指出，枯草桿菌的存活與蛋白產量取決於溶氧監測與主動曝氣／攪拌，而非單靠被動圍堵；植物耐逆性也取決於保護分子如何被調控，而不只是有沒有。
impact_en: [2026] An oxygen sensor and feedback loop moved up the hardware list (pH and DO sensors tested 5 August), some validation was to move to soil with larger samples, GMO rules in Taiwan, the Philippines, Malaysia and the EU went onto the research list, and agricultural-waste media such as hay infusion entered the business plan.
impact_zh: [2026] 氧氣感測器與回饋控制在硬體清單中優先排序（8 月 5 日測試 pH 與溶氧感測器）；部分驗證改到土壤並擴大樣本；臺灣、菲律賓、馬來西亞與歐盟的基改法規列入研究；乾草浸液等農業廢棄物培養基納入商業計畫。

expertise_en: Historical GIS; mapping methods
expertise_zh: 歷史地理資訊系統；製圖方法
summary_en: [2026] The team's GIS group presented the project to Daniel Viragh, creative director of the Berkeley Historical GIS Project, and came away with a method for mapping Taiwan's farmland.
summary_zh: [2026] 團隊的 GIS 小組向柏克萊歷史 GIS 計畫（Berkeley Historical GIS Project）創意總監 Daniel Viragh 簡報專案，並學到繪製臺灣農地地圖的方法。
impact_en: [2026] Provided the method used to map Taiwan's farmland in the geospatial analysis.
impact_zh: [2026] 提供地理空間分析中繪製臺灣農地的方法。

name_zh: 正瀚生技股份有限公司
organisation_zh: 正瀚生技股份有限公司
expertise_en: Plant biostimulants and bioprotectants; product registration and regulation
expertise_zh: 植物生物刺激素與生物保護劑；產品登記與法規
summary_en: [2026] On 9 July the team (with Prof. Chen) visited CH Biotech: researchers walked them past their published work and product line, and researcher Yuan Chiu-Ying (袁秋英) gave a regulatory briefing comparing fertilizer and pesticide pathways and permit requirements in Taiwan and abroad. They advised that different crops and protectants need different application methods, that cost per area decides usability, and that efficacy under heat or drought must be shown with several phenotypic measurements, and they gave the team their peptide product 富肽2號. On 5 September a CH Biotech expert spoke at the team's forum on using agricultural waste (e.g. feathers) to make signal-peptide biostimulants and on balancing growth and defence.
summary_zh: [2026] 7 月 9 日團隊與陳文亮教授一同參訪正瀚生技：研究人員帶領參觀其發表成果與產品線，研究員袁秋英並進行法規簡報，比較臺灣與各國肥料與農藥兩條路徑及許可證所需文件。他們建議不同作物與保護劑需要不同施用方式、單位面積成本決定可行性，並須以多項表型與生理指標證明在高溫或乾旱下的效果，也提供了胜肽產品「富肽2號」。9 月 5 日一位正瀚專家在團隊論壇分享以羽毛等農業廢棄物製作訊號胜肽生物刺激素，並強調生長與防禦之間的平衡。
impact_en: [2026] 富肽2號 became experiment set 7 (1:500, three treatment timings) and the positive control; the team compared root irrigation, foliar and drone spraying and cost per area, added computational screening and truncated peptides, and grounded its Laws and Regulations analysis in the CH Biotech briefing. The Wu summary notes the team's current regulatory positioning came from this conversation.
impact_zh: [2026] 「富肽2號」成為第 7 組實驗（1:500、三種處理時機）與陽性對照；團隊比較根部灌注、葉面噴灑與無人機噴灑及單位面積成本，加入計算篩選與截短胜肽，並以正瀚的簡報作為法規頁分析的基礎。給吳主任的摘要也提到，團隊目前的法規定位來自這次談話。

expertise_en: Elementary students (grades 4 to 6)
expertise_zh: 國小學生（四至六年級）
summary_en: [2026] Trials 1 and 3 of the 'Little Plant Guardians' workshop: 43 students on 25 and 26 June and 12 students on 14 July, with the leaf-disk experiment, chlorophyll extraction, DNA card game and self-watering planter, plus KAP pre- and post-surveys. (The plant page also mentions a session there on 2 July.)
summary_zh: [2026] 「小小植物守護者」工作坊第 1 與第 3 次試教：6 月 25、26 日共 43 名學生，7 月 14 日 12 名學生；內容包括葉圓片實驗、葉綠素萃取、DNA 卡牌遊戲與自動澆水盆栽，並進行 KAP 前後測。（植物頁另提到 7 月 2 日也在該校上課。）
impact_en: [2026] Student and teacher feedback led to more time per activity, louder audio and voices, a 1:5 mentor-to-student ratio for hands-on work, clearer rules at the start, more explanation of experiment results, and more English teaching.
impact_zh: [2026] 依學生與老師回饋，增加活動時間、提高音量、實作時採 1:5 的師生比、課前先建立規則、加強實驗結果說明，並增加英語教學。

name_en: Farmers at the Taipei Water Garden Organic Farmers' Market and public forum
name_zh: 臺北水花園有機農夫市集農友（論壇參與者）
organisation_en: Farmers at the Taipei Water Garden Organic Farmers' Market and public forum
organisation_zh: 臺北水花園有機農夫市集農友（論壇參與者）
expertise_en: Organic and small-scale farming across Nantou, Hualien, Hsinchu, Yilan and other regions (cocoa, rice, coffee, mixed grains)
expertise_zh: 南投、花蓮、新竹、宜蘭等地的有機與小規模農友（可可、稻米、咖啡、雜糧）
summary_en: [2026] At the team's forum and booth day, farmers from several regions shared their experience and questioned the speakers and the team; two questions were aimed at the team: whether using the bioreactor affects organic certification, and how many bioreactors one farm would need. Team members also interviewed stallholders for the GIS work, learning that organic certification and reducing labour are the main considerations for moving to sustainable, commercial practice and that most apply organic fertilizer on a fixed annual schedule. Forum KAP surveys were given to speakers, farmers and the public.
summary_zh: [2026] 在團隊的論壇與攤位活動中，來自各地的農友分享經驗，並向講者與團隊提問；其中兩個問題針對團隊：使用生物反應器是否影響有機驗證，以及一塊田需要幾台反應器。團隊也為 GIS 分析訪談攤商，得知有機驗證與減少勞力是農友轉向永續、商業化經營的主要考量，且多數依固定年度排程施用有機肥。論壇後對講者、農友與民眾分別發放 KAP 問卷。
impact_en: [2026] The two farmer questions were taken into the Laws and Regulations and Entrepreneurship work and remain open items; the interview data fed the GIS/geospatial analysis.
impact_zh: [2026] 農友的兩個問題分別納入法規與創業頁的工作，目前仍列為待解事項；訪談資料用於 GIS 地理空間分析。

expertise_en: Agricultural and green-living media; co-runs the Water Garden Organic Farmers' Market
expertise_zh: 農業與綠色生活媒體；共同經營水花園有機農夫市集
summary_en: [2026] In an early-July meeting Green Media explained that farmers, researchers and media hold different views on farming and that farmers may raise problems the team had not anticipated. On 5 September Green Media hosted the team's public forum 'Field Dialogue: Agricultural Solutions to Climate Change' at the Taipei Water Garden Organic Farmers' Market (more than 50 participants), alongside its own Taiwanese coffee and cocoa event, and afterwards published an article covering the forum.
summary_zh: [2026] 7 月初的會議中，綠媒體提醒團隊：農民、研究者與媒體看待農業的角度不同，農民也可能提出團隊沒預料到的問題。9 月 5 日綠媒體在臺北水花園有機農夫市集主辦團隊的公開論壇「田間對話：氣候變遷下的農業解方」（逾 50 人參加），同時結合其臺灣咖啡與可可活動，會後並刊出報導文章。
impact_en: [2026] The forum was restructured into three parts ending with an open floor so every participant, especially farmers, could speak; that session produced the two farmer questions on organic certification and units per farm. The team added a coffee and cocoa climate infographic booth, and the article increased the project's visibility.
impact_zh: [2026] 論壇因此改為三段式並以開放討論收尾，讓每位參與者（特別是農民）都能發言；農民關於有機驗證與每塊田需要幾台設備的兩個問題即出自這個環節。團隊另設咖啡與可可氣候資訊圖攤位，報導文章也提高了專案的能見度。

expertise_en: Natural farming without fertilizer or protectants; soil reading; seed saving
expertise_zh: 不施肥、不用保護劑的自然農法；看土；留種
summary_en: [2026] On 21 July she invited the team to her farm in Tamsui, where they harvested okra and luffa, knelt in her beds while she read the soil, and ate lunch cooked from what they picked. As a natural farmer she doubted whether technology helps at all and warned that over-intervention can stop plants building their own resilience; she also described seed lost to typhoons and floods and asked for a way for growers to exchange seed. An online follow-up call was held on 16 September.
summary_zh: [2026] 7 月 21 日她邀請團隊到她在淡水的農場，一起採收秋葵與絲瓜，蹲在田畦間看她如何讀土，並吃她用採收的菜煮的午餐。身為自然農法農友，她質疑科技是否真的有幫助，並提醒過度介入會讓植物失去自己建立韌性的能力；她也提到颱風、淹水後種子流失，希望有讓農友交換種子的管道。9 月 16 日團隊與她進行線上追蹤訪談。
impact_en: [2026] Her concern set a design principle: act only on forecast stress, at a validated dose, and then stop, which shaped how much protectant the business plan releases. Two days later the team prototyped a seed exchange platform, now part of the 農友助手 LINE account.
impact_zh: [2026] 她的顧慮成為設計原則：只在預測到逆境時、以驗證過的劑量作用，之後就停止，並影響商業計畫中保護劑的釋放量。兩天後團隊做出種子交換平台原型，現已納入「農友助手」LINE 帳號。

name_zh: 蘭陽溪友善耕作生產合作社
organisation_en: Lanyang River Friendly Farming Production Cooperative
organisation_zh: 蘭陽溪友善耕作生產合作社
expertise_en: Pesticide-, chemical-fertilizer- and herbicide-free farming and food processing
expertise_zh: 全程不用農藥、化肥與除草劑的耕作與農產加工
summary_en: [2026] Online meeting with Mr. Chen, founder of a cooperative that sells produce and processed foods grown without pesticides, chemical fertilizers or herbicides. He warned that a bioreactor on a farm could be damaged by natural disasters or wild animals, or B. subtilis could be intentionally released, and said different crops need different levels of intervention; some, such as strawberries, may need little or none. (The wiki dates this call from a screenshot taken 24 September.)
summary_zh: [2026] 與蘭陽溪友善耕作生產合作社創辦人陳先生線上會議；該合作社銷售全程不使用農藥、化肥與除草劑的農產品與加工品。他提醒放在田間的反應器可能因天災或野生動物受損，或枯草桿菌遭人故意釋出；也指出不同作物對逆境的承受力不同，例如草莓可能幾乎不需要介入。（wiki 依 9 月 24 日的會議截圖推定日期。）
impact_en: [2026] The risk was added to the threat analysis of the business plan and the biosafety approach was reconsidered; he encouraged a more targeted marketing strategy focused on specific crop groups.
impact_zh: [2026] 團隊將此風險納入商業計畫的威脅分析並重新檢視生物安全做法；他也建議針對特定作物族群制定更聚焦的行銷策略。

title_en: Researcher and Director, Biological Control Research Center
organisation_en: Miaoli District Agricultural Research and Extension Station, Ministry of Agriculture
organisation_zh: 農業部苗栗區農業改良場
unit_en: Biological Control Research Center
expertise_en: Biological control materials and their extension; beekeeping and honeybee pest management; natural-enemy habitat
expertise_zh: 生物防治資材應用與推廣；養蜂技術與蜜蜂病蟲害防治；天敵昆蟲棲地營造
summary_en: [2026] Director Wu sent the team questions over LINE, and the team replied with a one-page Traditional Chinese summary of ReLeaf (problem, solution, the year's interview record, key results and what is not yet done). The summary notes that the government cell on the team's stakeholder map was still empty, and asks her about how the station's extension system works, whether student teams can collaborate with it, how to find farmers or farmers' associations willing to trial the technology, what conditions (validation data, demonstration fields, support) make farmers try a new technology, and precedents of student or start-up technologies extended through the station. It requests a 20 to 30 minute interview, online or by phone.
summary_zh: [2026] 吳主任透過 LINE 向團隊提問，團隊以一頁繁體中文摘要回覆 ReLeaf 的問題、解方、這一年的訪談紀錄、關鍵結果與尚未完成的部分。摘要坦承利害關係人圖上「公部門」這一格仍是空的，並向她請教：農改場推廣體系如何運作、學生團隊是否有合作管道、如何媒合願意試用的農民或農會、新技術需具備哪些條件（驗證資料、示範田、輔導配套）農民才願意嘗試，以及過去是否有學生團隊或新創技術經農改場推廣落地的案例。文末邀請她撥 20 到 30 分鐘接受線上或電話訪談。
impact_en: [2026] First government-sector contact of the 2026 season, aimed at the lab-to-field step (extension, farmer matching, demonstration requirements). Outcome of the interview request not yet recorded.
impact_zh: [2026] 2026 年第一個公部門接觸，目標是從實驗室走到田間這一段（推廣體系、農民媒合、示範條件）。訪談邀約的結果尚未記錄。

unit_en: Department of Chemical Engineering
expertise_en: Biomanufacturing and bioreactor engineering; B. subtilis bioprocess; membrane reactors
expertise_zh: 生物製造與生物反應器工程；枯草桿菌生物製程；膜反應器
summary_en: [2026] On 18 June he visited the team to review the hollow-fibre membrane bioreactor: he advised on B. subtilis growth conditions, breaking foam mechanically (or a surfactant-deficient strain / defoamer), monitoring flow rate and transmembrane pressure to catch membrane caking, noted the membrane may be oversized, and found there was no driving force to push protectant through the membrane. On 4 September he returned to see the running reactor and wet-lab data, worked through protectant and cells crossing the membrane with no driving force, asked for a repeat 22 °C growth test and a plasmid stability check, and urged designing for the farmer who must operate it.
summary_zh: [2026] 6 月 18 日他到團隊檢視中空纖維膜生物反應器：建議枯草桿菌的培養條件、以機械方式破泡（或用缺界面活性素菌株、消泡劑），監測流速與跨膜壓差以及早發現膜結垢，指出膜可能過大，並發現設計中沒有推動保護劑穿過膜的驅動力。9 月 4 日他再度來訪，看了運轉中的反應器與濕實驗數據，協助分析保護劑與菌體在無驅動力下穿膜的問題，要求重做 22 °C 生長試驗與質體穩定性檢查，並提醒要為實際操作的農民設計。
impact_en: [2026] A stepper pinch valve after the membrane was posted the next day (later a servo), transmembrane pressure went onto a live screen, and pressure-tracking and foam-breaking entered the hardware spec. After September the design moved toward a modular, replaceable bacterial capsule with AIoT control; the passive membrane leak remains an open item.
impact_zh: [2026] 隔天團隊就提出膜後的步進馬達夾管閥（後改為伺服），跨膜壓差改為即時顯示，壓力追蹤與破泡機制寫入硬體規格。9 月後設計轉向模組化、可更換的菌匣與 AIoT 控制；膜在靜止時滲漏的問題仍待解決。

title_en: Distinguished Professor; Dean, College of Life Sciences
title_zh: 特聘教授；生命科學院院長
unit_en: Department of Life Sciences
expertise_en: Synthetic biology; microbiology; Bacillus genetics; plant endosymbiotic bacteria
expertise_zh: 合成生物學；微生物學；芽孢桿菌遺傳；植物內生菌
summary_en: [2026] On 28 July (online) he advised on timing, dose, sensing and application: biostimulants last longest applied at the seedling stage, too much stress or protectant harms the plant so thresholds and doses must be validated, and the reactor should run periodically when stress arrives, combining sensors with weather forecasts; he also gave cloning advice (dense pellets and more DNA for electroporation, vector and no-plasmid controls). On 6 August the team visited him at NCHU, where he advised on expression and secretion, a stated rationale for each salt and heat condition, and shorter or modified peptides chosen by receptor-peptide interactions, and gave them B. subtilis WB800. He then invited the team to the 2nd ISLSDR symposium.
summary_zh: [2026] 7 月 28 日（線上）他就時機、劑量、感測與施用提供建議：生物刺激素在幼苗期施用效果最持久；逆境或保護劑過量都會傷害植物，須驗證閾值與劑量；反應器應在逆境來臨時週期性運轉，並結合感測器與天氣預報；也給了選殖建議（電穿孔用高密度菌體與較多 DNA、加入空載體與無質體對照）。8 月 6 日團隊到中興大學拜訪他，他就表現與分泌、每種鹽與高溫條件的實驗理由、以受體－胜肽交互作用挑選較短或修飾過的胜肽提供建議，並給了枯草桿菌 WB800 菌株。之後他邀請團隊參加第二屆 ISLSDR 研討會。
impact_en: [2026] The reactor was reframed to run periodically on forecast stress, electroporation was reworked with control groups, module 4's terminator returned to B0015 after he said recombination in Bacillus was not the problem, and protein quantity, identity, solubility and function are now evaluated together. WB800 became a new secretion chassis.
impact_zh: [2026] 反應器改為依預測逆境週期性運轉；電穿孔流程重整並加入對照組；他認為芽孢桿菌的重組不是問題後，第 4 模組的終止子改回 B0015；蛋白的產量、身分、溶解度與功能改為一併評估。WB800 成為新的分泌用底盤菌。

unit_en: Department of Plant Pathology
expertise_en: Bacillus-based microbial formulations; plant stress-resistance materials; protectant delivery
expertise_zh: 芽孢桿菌微生物製劑；植物抗逆資材；保護劑施用
summary_en: [2026] A second NCHU consultation on 6 August, evaluating the B. subtilis engineering strategy, protectant delivery, plant testing systems and agricultural applications. She discussed optimising bacterial production, protectant concentration and application timing, and delivery methods such as irrigation, spraying and seed coating, since the bacteria stay inside the reactor.
summary_zh: [2026] 8 月 6 日在中興大學的第二場諮詢，評估枯草桿菌工程策略、保護劑施用、植物測試系統與農業應用。由於菌體留在反應器內，她與團隊討論如何優化菌體生產、保護劑濃度與施用時機，以及灌溉、噴灑、種子披衣等施用方式。
impact_en: [2026] The team recognised that effectiveness depends on how much protectant reaches the plant, when and how often, not only whether B. subtilis produces it, and that optimising the culture medium may ease the trade-off between growth and protein output.
impact_zh: [2026] 團隊體認到系統效果不只取決於枯草桿菌是否產生保護劑，還取決於有多少到達植物、何時送達與施用頻率；優化培養基也可能緩解菌體生長與蛋白產量之間的取捨。

unit_en: Department of Biochemical Science and Technology
expertise_en: Plant and stress biology; Arabidopsis growth and stress assays
expertise_zh: 植物與逆境生物學；阿拉伯芥栽培與逆境試驗
summary_en: [2026] On 27 March the team visited her lab at NTU with no plants and no protocol; she agreed with heat, salinity and drought as target stresses and Arabidopsis as the model, warned that hydroponics alone is unstable, showed her plates and home-made hydroponic boxes, and gave the team Arabidopsis seed. On 28 August the team returned with a progress report, two hydroponic boxes and eight experiment sets; her rulings (written up 2 September) set plant age at 10 to 20 days, a 200 mM salt ceiling, treatment by transfer instead of spraying, and found the gradual soil salt ramp too mild.
summary_zh: [2026] 3 月 27 日團隊在沒有植物、也沒有實驗流程的情況下拜訪她在臺大的實驗室；她認同以高溫、鹽害、乾旱為目標逆境並以阿拉伯芥為模式植物，提醒單靠水耕不穩定，示範了培養盤與自製水耕盒，並提供阿拉伯芥種子。8 月 28 日團隊帶著進度報告、兩套水耕盒與八組實驗數據回訪；她的建議（9 月 2 日整理）將植株年齡定為 10 至 20 天、鹽濃度上限 200 mM、以移植到含處理的培養盤取代噴灑，並指出土壤漸進加鹽的做法太溫和。
impact_en: [2026] The plant model switched from Medicago to Arabidopsis on agar then soil, osmotic stress was dropped, and her hydroponic box design was copied. Her August rulings became experiment set 8 (ten-day plants treated by transfer). The development page records that she later adopted the team's design for use with her graduate students.
impact_zh: [2026] 植物模型由苜蓿改為先在洋菜培養盤、後移入土壤的阿拉伯芥，刪除滲透逆境，並仿製她的水耕盒設計。她 8 月的建議成為第 8 組實驗（十日齡植株、以移植處理）。開發頁記載她之後將團隊的設計用於她的研究生。

organisation_en: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University
unit_en: Department of Biological Science and Technology
expertise_en: AIoT and smart agriculture; sensor-based crop management; agri-tech entrepreneurship
expertise_zh: AIoT 與智慧農業；感測器作物管理；農業科技創業
summary_en: [2026] On 10 April (online) he told the team to treat the hardware as the printer and the biofertilizer as the ink, drop soil moisture sensing, leave open-soil release for a contained bioreactor, define input-output mapping and plan beyond the small local market. On 20 June he visited the team and reviewed the math model, plant model, protectant, hydroponics, circuit and reactor, taking apart the proposed auto-filling reservoir and urging a feedback loop between model and bench; he also joined the 9 July CH Biotech visit. On 5 September he spoke at the team's public forum on smart agriculture, arguing protection should depend on whether the plant can keep growing under stress.
summary_zh: [2026] 4 月 10 日（線上）他建議把硬體當成「印表機」、生物肥料當成「墨水」，放棄土壤濕度感測，不要把工程菌釋放到開放土壤而改用封閉式生物反應器，明確定義輸入輸出，並跳脫太小的本地市場。6 月 20 日他到團隊檢視數學模型、植物模型、保護劑、水耕、基因線路與反應器，否決了自動補水槽構想，並要求模型與實驗形成回饋迴路；7 月 9 日也一同參訪正瀚生技。9 月 5 日他在團隊的公開論壇以智慧農業為題演講，主張應依植物在逆境下能否持續生長來決定保護措施。
impact_en: [2026] Triggered the 15 April pivot from soil release to a contained, light-gated bioreactor and the cartridge (consumable) business model, plus a competitive analysis. After June the model was connected to wet-lab data, salt dose-by-time series and dissolved-oxygen monitoring were added, and he sent the team to Yes Health iFarm.
impact_zh: [2026] 促成 4 月 15 日由土壤釋放轉為封閉、光控生物反應器的轉向，以及「賣耗材（菌匣）」的商業模式與競品分析。6 月後模型與濕實驗數據串接，加入鹽濃度與處理時間系列及溶氧監測，並由他引薦參訪源鮮智慧農場。

unit_en: Department of Chemical Engineering
expertise_en: Plant biochemistry; plant metabolic pathways; protectant design
expertise_zh: 植物生化；植物代謝路徑；保護劑設計
summary_en: [2026] On 27 June (online) she evaluated the protectant selection, delivery strategy and project direction, said the proof of concept as planned might not succeed, and told the team to write down goals and milestones, do one stress well, validate the purified protectant on plants before integrating it, and consider peptides. On 12 September she reviewed the work again with Prof. Drew Endy, focusing on experimental design, controls and showing that the bacteria make and secrete ACC deaminase.
summary_zh: [2026] 6 月 27 日（線上）她評估了保護劑選擇、遞送策略與整體方向，指出原本的概念驗證可能不成立，要求團隊寫下目標與里程碑、專注把一種逆境做好、先把純化保護劑直接施用在植物上驗證再整合進系統，並考慮胜肽類分子。9 月 12 日她與 Drew Endy 教授再次審閱，重點放在實驗設計、對照組，以及證明細菌確實產生並分泌 ACC 去胺酶。
impact_en: [2026] Direct plant assays with applied protectant (including CH Biotech's peptide as set 7) came before reactor integration, a peptide design track began, and the protectant set was fixed to ACC deaminase, BoPep4 and LEA14. After September, controls were expanded and ACCD verification at RNA and protein level was added.
impact_zh: [2026] 先以直接施用保護劑的植物試驗驗證（包括以正瀚生技胜肽為第 7 組），再整合進反應器；開啟胜肽設計分支，並將保護劑定為 ACC 去胺酶、BoPep4 與 LEA14。9 月後擴充對照組，並加入 RNA 與蛋白層級的 ACCD 驗證。

unit_en: Department of Bioengineering
expertise_en: Plant synthetic biology; gene circuit design; biocontainment
expertise_zh: 植物合成生物學；基因線路設計；生物圍堵
summary_en: [2026] Online meeting in which the team reviewed its signal-route options and the B. subtilis circuit and hardware design with her. She highlighted several problems with relying on a kill switch (kill switches can mutate away) and advised making physical containment the primary safety mechanism, with a semi-permeable membrane that keeps bacteria in and lets protectant out.
summary_zh: [2026] 線上會議中，團隊與她討論訊號路徑選項以及枯草桿菌的基因線路與硬體設計。她指出只依賴自殺開關的多項問題（自殺開關可能因突變失效），建議以物理圍堵為主要安全機制，並設計能留住細菌、讓保護劑通過的半透膜。
impact_en: [2026] Physical containment became the primary biosafety layer, a kill switch was demoted to an optional second layer, and the hollow-fibre membrane design followed a week later.
impact_zh: [2026] 物理圍堵成為主要生物安全機制，自殺開關降為可選的第二層防護；一週後團隊畫出中空纖維膜設計。

unit_en: Department of Bioengineering
expertise_en: Synthetic biology; biological engineering
expertise_zh: 合成生物學；生物工程
summary_en: [2026] Joined Dr. Sattely for the team's second Stanford review (online). They focused on how the team presents its experimental design, controls, mechanism and the role of ACCD, told the team to distinguish clearly between the engineered B. subtilis and the protectant delivered to plants, to show the bacteria produce and secrete ACCD, and to say what each experiment was for and what its result shows. He also made the same point as the NCHU symposium about stating the finding in every slide title.
summary_zh: [2026] 與 Sattely 博士一同進行團隊第二次史丹佛審閱（線上）。他們著重團隊如何呈現實驗設計、對照組、作用機制與 ACCD 的角色，要求清楚區分工程枯草桿菌與實際遞送給植物的保護劑、證明細菌能產生並分泌 ACCD，並說明每個實驗的目的與結果代表什麼。他也提出與中興大學研討會相同的建議：每張投影片標題要直接寫出發現。
impact_en: [2026] Controls were expanded to isolate bacterial output from plant responses, RNA and protein verification of ACCD was added, and the narrative was restructured to separate the biological mechanism from the hardware delivery platform.
impact_zh: [2026] 擴充對照組以區分菌體產物與植物反應，加入 ACCD 的 RNA 與蛋白層級驗證，並重整敘事，把生物機制與硬體遞送平台分開說明。

name_en: Taipei Expo Farmers' Market (smallholder and organic farmers)
organisation_en: Taipei Expo Farmers' Market (smallholder and organic farmers)
expertise_en: Smallholder and organic farming practice
expertise_zh: 小農與有機耕作實務
summary_en: [2026] The team's first farmer outreach: members interviewed organic and smallholder stallholders at the Taipei Expo Farmers' Market about which environmental stresses hurt their crops most and how they feel about technology on the farm. Farmers named pests, pathogens, water shortage and unpredictable weather before salt, and the cost of every fix.
summary_zh: [2026] 團隊第一次農民外展：在花博農民市集訪談有機與小農攤商，詢問哪些環境逆境對作物影響最大，以及他們對農業科技的看法。農民先提到的是病蟲害、缺水與難以預測的天氣，其次才是鹽害，以及每種解方的成本。
impact_en: [2026] Biotic stress entered the project scope (forecasting and farmer tools), the business plan had to answer that technology must be affordable, accessible and practical, and the finding that information never reaches farmers led to the 農友助手 LINE platform.
impact_zh: [2026] 將生物性逆境納入專案範圍（預測與農民工具），商業計畫須回應「科技要便宜、易取得、實用」的要求；而「資訊到不了農民手上」的發現促成了「農友助手」LINE 平台。

name_zh: 臺北市私立復興實驗高級中學
organisation_zh: 臺北市私立復興實驗高級中學
expertise_en: High school students, grades 10 to 12
expertise_zh: 高中學生（10 至 12 年級）
summary_en: [2026] Workshop 'Decoding the Genetic Code: From DNA to the Future of Food Security' for a class of 28: an introduction to iGEM and synthetic biology, plant stress, an onion-cell plasmolysis experiment in 3 M and 6 M salt, a leaf-disk photosynthesis video, the ReLeaf bioreactor, and a transcription and translation mutation game, with Kahoot pre-survey and KAP post-survey. The homeroom teacher also filled in a feedback survey. (The plant page mentions an earlier session at Fushing in June.)
summary_zh: [2026] 為 28 名學生開設「解碼基因：從 DNA 到糧食安全的未來」工作坊：介紹 iGEM 與合成生物學、植物逆境、以 3 M 與 6 M 鹽水進行洋蔥細胞質壁分離實驗、葉圓片光合作用影片、ReLeaf 生物反應器，以及轉錄轉譯突變遊戲，並以 Kahoot 前測與 KAP 後測評估。班導師也填寫了回饋問卷。（植物頁提到 6 月在復興另有一次課程。）
impact_en: [2026] Students asked for clearer explanations of how DNA is modified and how mutations occur, louder voices, bigger fonts and fewer words per slide; the team plans more interactive elements since the hands-on plasmolysis question scored highest.
impact_zh: [2026] 學生希望更清楚說明 DNA 如何被修改與突變如何發生，並建議講者音量加大、字體放大、投影片字數減少；由於動手做的質壁分離題答對率最高，團隊計畫增加更多互動環節。

name_en: Taiwan SMART Agriweek 2026 (exhibitors and government sectors)
organisation_en: Taiwan SMART Agriweek 2026 (exhibitors and government sectors)
expertise_en: Agricultural technology exhibition; smart-farming products
expertise_zh: 農業科技展覽；智慧農業產品
summary_en: [2026] The team took the business case to the Smart Agriweek exhibition floor. Exhibitors indicated that young farmers are the likely early adopters while older farmers need convincing, that regulation will be hard for a GMO-based product, that one device replacing several products (e.g. BioBar and Agriweather) is a price advantage, and government sectors signalled they may help subsidise products like theirs.
summary_zh: [2026] 團隊把商業構想帶到智慧農業週展場檢驗。交流中得知：年輕農民最可能率先採用，年長農民則需另外說服；使用基改生物的產品在法規上會很困難；一台設備取代多項產品（如 BioBar 與 Agriweather）具價格優勢；政府部門也表示可能補助這類產品。
impact_en: [2026] The target user and pricing case on the Entrepreneurship page were revised around young farmers and the multi-product value case.
impact_zh: [2026] 創業頁的目標客群與定價論述改以年輕農民及「一機多用」的價值為核心。

expertise_en: Social enterprise connecting smallholder farmers to markets; climate impacts on farming in Ghana
expertise_zh: 協助小農直接銷售、減少中間商的社會企業；迦納氣候對農業的衝擊
summary_en: [2026] Early in the project the team talked online with the leader of Ubuntu Social Enterprise Ghana, which sells farmers' products for them so they avoid middlemen. They learned that climate is actively harming crops and making it harder to farm on generational land, and that farming families must trade off between eating and earning. The milestone page's first Human Practices meeting (1 February, the first time the pitch went outside the team) carries a photo file named for Gilbert Nkpeniyeng.
summary_zh: [2026] 專案初期，團隊與迦納 Ubuntu 社會企業（USE-GH）的負責人線上交流；該社企代農民銷售產品，讓他們不必經過中間商。團隊得知氣候正實際傷害作物，讓世代耕作的土地愈來愈難經營，務農家庭常得在「自己吃」與「拿去賣」之間取捨。里程碑頁的第一次人類實踐會議（2 月 1 日，首次對團隊外部簡報）照片檔名標有 Gilbert Nkpeniyeng。
impact_en: [2026] Inspired the initial project pitch and the social-enterprise model in the business plan, and supplied the account of climate damage on generational farmland used under SDG 2 and SDG 10 on the Sustainability page.
impact_zh: [2026] 啟發了最初的專案構想與商業計畫中的社會企業模式，並提供永續頁 SDG 2 與 SDG 10 所引用的世代農地受氣候損害的第一手描述。

expertise_en: Smallholder vegetable farming; climate resilience; biotic and abiotic stress
expertise_zh: 小農蔬菜生產；氣候韌性；生物與非生物逆境
summary_en: [2026] Online meeting on the challenges smallholder farmers face, including climate resilience and the combined effect of biotic and abiotic stresses. They advised staying with heat stress, since other stresses are harder to combat, sensing root pressure if pathogens are addressed, and aiming for a sustainable-farming label.
summary_zh: [2026] 線上會議，討論小農面臨的挑戰，包括氣候韌性以及生物與非生物逆境的共同影響。他們建議專注在高溫逆境（其他逆境較難對付），若要處理病原可改為偵測根壓，並以永續農業標章為目標。
impact_en: [2026] The team recognised it must show the product is environmentally safe, beneficial and sustainable to win acceptance from traditional and natural farmers, added GMO regulatory research, and targeted a sustainable-farming label rather than organic certification.
impact_zh: [2026] 團隊體認到必須證明產品對環境安全、有益且永續，才能被傳統與自然農法農民接受；因此加入基改法規研究，並以永續農業標章而非有機驗證為目標。

name_en: Yes Health iFarm (YesHealth Agri-Biotechnology Co., Ltd.)
name_zh: 源鮮智慧農場（源鮮農業生物科技股份有限公司）
organisation_en: Yes Health iFarm (YesHealth Agri-Biotechnology Co., Ltd.)
organisation_zh: 源鮮智慧農場（源鮮農業生物科技股份有限公司）
expertise_en: Controlled-environment indoor vertical hydroponic farming
expertise_zh: 環控室內垂直水耕農場
summary_en: [2026] Sent by Prof. Chen, the team visited this commercial indoor vertical hydroponic farm, stood under a wall of hydroponic channels, looked at how the float plate is carried from below, and put questions to the farm's director on environmental monitoring, nutrients, lighting, aeration and circulation. Some exact technical data they asked for was not available to them.
summary_zh: [2026] 經陳文亮教授引薦，團隊參觀這座商業化室內垂直水耕農場，站在整面水耕槽牆下，從下方觀察浮板如何被支撐，並向農場負責人請教環境監測、養分、光照、曝氣與循環等問題。部分團隊想要的精確技術數據無法取得。
impact_en: [2026] The team reconsidered its 16/8 light cycle against 12/12, added dissolved oxygen (and possibly OD) to reactor parameters, switched the growth chamber to gentle aeration and circulation instead of pure oxygen, minimised plant transfers, and redrew the float-plate CAD the same day. It also suggested ReLeaf could grow into detecting nutrient deficiency.
impact_zh: [2026] 團隊重新評估 16/8 與 12/12 光週期、將溶氧（或 OD）納入反應器參數、生長箱改為溫和曝氣與循環而非純氧、減少植株移植，並在當天就修改浮板 CAD。也啟發 ReLeaf 未來可擴展到偵測養分缺乏。

name_zh: 新北市永和區永平國民小學
organisation_zh: 新北市永和區永平國民小學
expertise_en: Elementary students (grades 4 to 6)
expertise_zh: 國小學生（四至六年級）
summary_en: [2026] Preliminary trial of the elementary workshop 'Little Plant Guardians: Combating Environmental Stress' (16 pre-survey, 12 post-survey students): climate change and plant stress, the spinach leaf-disk photosynthesis experiment with heat, ATCG base pairing and synthetic biology, a DNA card game, and a self-watering PET-bottle planter.
summary_zh: [2026] 國小工作坊「小小植物守護者：對抗環境逆境」的預試（前測 16 人、後測 12 人）：內容包括氣候變遷與植物逆境、加熱的菠菜葉圓片光合作用實驗、ATCG 配對與合成生物學、DNA 卡牌遊戲，以及寶特瓶自動澆水盆栽。
impact_en: [2026] Feedback on teamwork led the team to reinforce pre-session briefings so each member knew their role.
impact_zh: [2026] 依據團隊合作方面的回饋，加強課前簡報，確保每位成員清楚自己的角色與補位方式。

expertise_en: Biotechnology and materials science; computational modelling; site-directed mutagenesis
expertise_zh: 生物技術與材料科學；計算模擬；定點突變
summary_en: [2025] On the Entrepreneurship page's stakeholder map, Academia Sinica is listed under "Manage Closely": the team says it collaborated with Academia Sinica researchers on computational modelling and site-directed mutagenesis strategies. No researcher, lab or date is named, and it is not listed on the Attributions form.
summary_zh: [2025] 創業頁面的利害關係人地圖將中央研究院列為「密切管理」對象，團隊表示曾與中研院研究人員合作計算模擬與定點突變策略。頁面未寫出研究人員、實驗室或日期，致謝表中也沒有列出。
impact_en: [2025] Helped refine the design of the TfCut2 variants and, per the team, added technical credibility.
impact_zh: [2025] 協助修正 TfCut2 變異株的設計，團隊認為也提升了技術可信度。

expertise_en: Microbial engineering; bio-encapsulation; enzymatic and microbial plastic degradation; bio-prospecting
expertise_zh: 微生物工程；生物包埋；酵素與微生物塑膠降解；生物探勘
summary_en: [2025] The team met Dr. Gnyawali, co-founder and CSO of Breaking (a plastic-degradation company and former Harvard Wyss Institute researcher), to discuss plastic degradation and possible collaboration. He explained that a single enzyme cannot handle every form of PET, so multi-enzyme or sequential strategies are needed, warned that TPA accumulation lowers pH and destabilises enzymes, introduced Breaking's bio-prospecting pipeline, and discussed policy context such as the UN Global Plastic Treaty. He expressed interest in co-hosting seminars and collaborating on lab tasks and encouraged the team to explore the health impacts of micro- and nanoplastics.
summary_zh: [2025] 團隊與塑膠降解公司 Breaking 的共同創辦人暨科學長 Gnyawali 博士（曾任哈佛 Wyss 研究所研究員）會談，討論塑膠降解與合作可能。他說明單一酵素無法處理所有型態的 PET，需要多酵素或分段降解策略，提醒 TPA 累積會降低 pH 並使酵素不穩定，介紹 Breaking 的生物探勘流程，並談到聯合國全球塑膠公約等政策背景。他表示有興趣合辦講座與合作實驗，並鼓勵團隊探討微／奈米塑膠對健康的影響。
impact_en: [2025] Reinforced a sequential, multi-enzyme strategy with pH control and by-product management, inspired consideration of environmental sourcing for enzyme discovery, and opened potential collaboration on lab work and outreach.
impact_zh: [2025] 強化團隊採用分段、多酵素並搭配 pH 控制與副產物管理的策略，啟發以環境採樣發掘酵素的思路，並開啟實驗與推廣合作的可能。

name_zh: 華通電腦股份有限公司
organisation_zh: 華通電腦股份有限公司
expertise_en: Instrumental analysis (SEM, FT-IR, DSC, HPLC)
expertise_zh: 儀器分析（SEM、FT-IR、DSC、HPLC）
summary_en: [2025] COMPEQ provided and operated the SEM, FT-IR, DSC and HPLC equipment used in the project and supplied the analysis results; it is listed as a sponsor on the Attributions form.
summary_zh: [2025] 華通電腦提供並協助操作本專案使用的 SEM、FT-IR、DSC 與 HPLC 設備，並提供分析結果；致謝表將其列為贊助單位。
impact_en: [2025] Enabled the crystallinity (DSC), morphology (SEM) and chemical-structure (FT-IR) measurements that validated the pretreatment and degradation results.
impact_zh: [2025] 使團隊得以進行結晶度（DSC）、表面形貌（SEM）與化學結構（FT-IR）量測，驗證前處理與降解成果。

name_en: Cerebral Palsy Association of the R.O.C.
name_zh: 中華民國腦性麻痺協會
organisation_en: Cerebral Palsy Association of the R.O.C.

expertise_en: Support for people with cerebral palsy and their families
expertise_zh: 腦性麻痺者及其家庭支持服務
summary_en: [2025] Proceeds from the team's flea-market booth and activities (and future events) are donated to the Cerebral Palsy Association of the R.O.C. to support families affected by cerebral palsy, many of whose parents work for Story Wear. The Human Practices page describes the recipient as a non-profit supporting parents who work for Story Wear.
summary_zh: [2025] 團隊二手市集攤位與活動（及日後活動）的收入捐給中華民國腦性麻痺協會，支持腦性麻痺兒家庭，其中許多家長在 Story Wear 工作。人類實踐頁面將受捐單位描述為支持 Story Wear 員工家長的非營利組織。
impact_en: [2025] Linked the team's circular-fashion outreach to social inclusion (SDG 11).
impact_zh: [2025] 將團隊的循環時尚推廣與社會共融（SDG 11）連結。

title_zh: 林口長庚臨床毒物中心主任
unit_en: Clinical Poison Center
expertise_en: Clinical toxicology; health effects of plastics and microplastics
expertise_zh: 臨床毒物學；塑膠與微塑膠對健康的影響
summary_en: [2025] Dr. Yen Tzung-Hai spoke on the expert panel at the team's Dadaocheng community sustainability event, discussing the impact of plastic on human health (panel "Microplastic Pollution Effect on Human Health") and emphasising the environmental urgency of textile waste. The wiki names him but does not state his affiliation; the affiliation here is from public sources.
summary_zh: [2025] 顏宗海醫師在團隊於大稻埕舉辦的社區永續活動中擔任座談講者，談塑膠對人體健康的影響（「微塑膠污染對人體健康的影響」座談），並強調紡織廢棄物的環境急迫性。wiki 只寫出姓名、未註明單位，此處單位依公開資料補充。
impact_en: [2025] His medical explanations supported the microplastics-and-health booth and were used to address respondents who underestimated the seriousness of textile waste.
impact_zh: [2025] 他的醫學說明支援了「微塑膠與健康」攤位，並用來回應低估紡織廢棄物嚴重性的受訪者。

unit_en: University students (bioscience programmes)
unit_zh: 大學生（生命科學相關科系）
expertise_en: University bioscience study; iGEM participation
expertise_zh: 大學生命科學學習；iGEM 參賽經驗
summary_en: [2025] University students (named as "China Medical University (CSMU)" on the Education page) co-designed the teaching slides and plans for the Xisong High School session and shared their experience of university bioscience programmes, iGEM, entrance exams and science competitions, leading a mentorship Q&A on careers.
summary_zh: [2025] 大學生（教育頁寫為「China Medical University (CSMU)」）與團隊共同設計西松高中的教材與教案，並分享大學生命科學課程、iGEM、升學考試與科學競賽經驗，帶領生涯導師問答。
impact_en: [2025] Added mentorship and career exploration to the high school programme.
impact_zh: [2025] 為高中課程加入導師指導與生涯探索。

name_zh: 得力實業股份有限公司
organisation_zh: 得力實業股份有限公司
expertise_en: Midstream functional and sustainable fabric development; recycled-material fabrics for global brands
expertise_zh: 中游機能與永續布料開發；為國際品牌生產含再生原料的布料
summary_en: [2025] The team met De Licacy, a Taiwanese midstream textile manufacturer with over ten years of fabric development, to explore turning the team's monomers back into textiles. They explained that recycled PET comes mostly from bottles, so bottle-rPET is cheap while textile-to-textile recycling still faces high collection and processing costs, that performance and outdoor brands with eco-conscious customers are the most promising first market, and that Taiwan's strength is agility in functional fabrics. Manufacturers' priorities for adoption are monomer purity, scalability and stability, and above all cost competitiveness.
summary_zh: [2025] 團隊與擁有十多年布料開發經驗的臺灣中游紡織廠得力實業會談，探討將團隊的單體再製成布料。對方說明目前再生 PET 多來自寶特瓶，瓶回收成熟、價差小，而布對布回收仍面臨高收集與處理成本；機能與戶外品牌的消費者較具環保意識，是新回收技術最有希望的首批市場；臺灣的優勢在於機能布料與快速導入創新。製造商最重視的是單體純度、規模化與穩定性，其中成本競爭力最為關鍵。
impact_en: [2025] Helped define scale-up expectations (high monomer purity, reliable scalability, cost competitiveness) and identified performance-textile brands as early adopters, focusing the team on industry-ready, economically viable enzyme systems.
impact_zh: [2025] 協助團隊定義放大的條件（高單體純度、可靠的規模化、成本競爭力），並將機能布料品牌視為早期採用者，使團隊聚焦於可產業化且具經濟可行性的酵素系統。

name_zh: 和友紡織股份有限公司
title_en: ESG Sustainability Manager (formerly Project Manager, Taiwan Circular Economy Foundation)
title_zh: ESG 永續經理（曾任臺灣循環經濟相關基金會專案經理）
organisation_zh: 和友紡織股份有限公司
expertise_en: Circular economy projects across the textile supply chain; recycling infrastructure and policy
expertise_zh: 紡織供應鏈循環經濟專案；回收基礎設施與政策
summary_en: [2025] The team met Ms. Chiang, ESG Sustainability Manager at Ho Yu Textile and former project manager at the Taiwan Circular Economy Foundation, to identify gaps in Taiwan's recycling industry. She explained that chemical recycling has strong potential but needs high investment and has higher emissions, that gaps remain in collection and pretreatment with little government funding, contrasted Germany's state-backed system with Taiwan's self-driven efforts, and noted limited domestic demand for recycled textiles and the difficulty of verifying recycled content.
summary_zh: [2025] 團隊與和友紡織 ESG 永續經理江女士（曾任臺灣循環經濟相關基金會專案經理）會談，找出臺灣回收產業的缺口。她說明化學回收潛力大但投資高、排放也較高；收集與前處理環節仍有缺口且政府資金不足；並比較德國由國家支持的體系與臺灣多靠業者自發的現況，也指出國內再生紡織品需求有限、再生成分驗證不易。
impact_en: [2025] Verified the team's assumption that current recycling systems have gaps and clarified the project's role as a more sustainable solution that improves on other recycling pathways; made the team more aware of the need to seek the right (often overseas) markets.
impact_zh: [2025] 證實團隊對現行回收體系存在缺口的假設，並釐清專案的角色是提出比其他回收途徑更永續的解方；也讓團隊意識到必須主動尋找合適（常在海外）的市場。

name_zh: 財團法人臺北市華興育幼院
organisation_zh: 財團法人臺北市華興育幼院
expertise_en: Residential care for orphans and vulnerable children aged 3-18
expertise_zh: 收容 3–18 歲孤兒與弱勢兒童的育幼機構
summary_en: [2025] As inclusive education, the team adapted its "Enzyme Heroes: Save Our Clothes!" lesson for grades 1-7 children at Huaxing Children's Home, a residential facility for orphans and vulnerable children placed through government referrals. The session put extra emphasis on hands-on, visual and story-driven activities, split students into smaller age groups, and framed science as a tool for kindness, environmental protection and self-confidence.
summary_zh: [2025] 在包容性教育方面，團隊為華興育幼院（收容經政府轉介之孤兒與弱勢兒童的機構）一至七年級的孩子調整「酵素英雄：拯救我們的衣服！」教案，加重實作、視覺與故事活動，依年齡分成小組，並把科學呈現為善意、環境保護與自信的工具。
impact_en: [2025] Children responded very positively; the team learned to add structured transitions, tiered tasks and more sensory/movement elements for mixed-age groups.
impact_zh: [2025] 孩子們反應熱烈；團隊也學到面對混齡學生時要加入更有結構的轉換、分級任務與更多感官／肢體活動。

title_en: Researcher (Manager, Material and Chemical Research Laboratories)
title_zh: 材料與化工研究所經理
organisation_zh: 財團法人工業技術研究院
unit_en: Material and Chemical Research Laboratories
expertise_en: Textile sorting and recycling technology; Raman/NIR spectroscopy for fibre identification
expertise_zh: 廢紡織品分選與回收技術；以拉曼／近紅外光譜辨識纖維
summary_en: [2025] The team consulted Dr. Chu on technical strategies for degrading PET/cotton blends. He pressed the team to clarify whether the goal was PET recycling, cotton recycling or full separation, recommended Raman over NIR spectroscopy for multi-material textiles, suggested UV/Raman or digest analysis to monitor degradation in real time, noted PET content should ideally be at least 80% and that alkali dye-removal pretreatment may help, and explained the limits of mechanical and chemical separation and of current Raman/NIR sorting in Taiwan.
summary_zh: [2025] 團隊向朱博士請教 PET／棉混紡布降解的技術策略。他要求團隊釐清目標是 PET 回收、棉回收或完全分離，建議以拉曼光譜取代近紅外光分析多材質紡織品，並建議以 UV／拉曼或消化液分析即時監測降解；他指出 PET 含量最好在 80% 以上、高溫鹼處理去染可能提升效率，也說明機械與化學分離以及臺灣現有拉曼／近紅外分選技術的限制。
impact_en: [2025] The team decided to prioritise PET degradation as the first milestone instead of simultaneous PET-cotton breakdown, streamlined enzyme engineering around TfCut2, added pretreatment to the experimental design, and considered Raman screening of PET% and real-time spectroscopic monitoring for hardware and pretreatment protocols.
impact_zh: [2025] 團隊決定以 PET 降解為第一階段目標，而非同時分解 PET 與棉，並聚焦 TfCut2 的酵素工程、把前處理納入實驗設計，也考慮以拉曼預篩 PET 含量及以光譜即時監測，應用於硬體與前處理流程。

expertise_en: Used-clothing collection, sorting and recycling (over a hundred tons per month)
expertise_zh: 舊衣回收、分類與再利用（每月上百噸）
summary_en: [2025] The team met Mr. Wu, CEO of Jiutai, a textile recycler handling over a hundred tons of used clothing monthly, to plan a visit and collaboration and learn about recycling barriers. He explained that clothes from donation bins are manually stripped of zippers and labels, PET content is measured by light-based machines, high-purity PET goes to chemical recycling while blends are burned, and that over 80% of PET clothing is recyclable only if clean and pure; he noted per-kilogram subsidies from the Ministry of Environment but little brand or legal pressure. During the later site visit the team saw the sorting process and the volume of clothing awaiting recycling.
summary_zh: [2025] 團隊與每月處理上百噸舊衣的久泰吳先生會談，規劃參訪與合作並了解回收障礙。他說明回收箱的衣物需人工拆除拉鍊、標籤，再以光學設備測 PET 含量，高純度 PET 送化學回收，混紡則被焚化；PET 衣物超過 80% 可回收，但前提是乾淨且純；他也提到環境部有按公斤補助，但品牌與法規壓力仍不足。後續實地參訪時，團隊看到分類流程與大量待回收的衣物。
impact_en: [2025] Jiutai offered real blended-fabric samples for lab testing and competitive pricing for large quantities of sorted used clothes, becoming the upstream feedstock partner in the business model (Jiutai upstream to Kingwhale downstream); the meeting also pushed the team to treat policy as part of the project.
impact_zh: [2025] 久泰願意提供真實混紡布樣品供實驗測試，並以具競爭力的價格供應大量已分類舊衣，成為商業模式中的上游原料夥伴（久泰上游、菁華下游）；此次會談也促使團隊把政策納入專案考量。

name_zh: 菁華工業股份有限公司
organisation_zh: 菁華工業股份有限公司
expertise_en: Functional and sustainable textiles for outdoor/performance brands; recycled PET fabrics
expertise_zh: 戶外與機能品牌用永續機能布料；再生 PET 布料
summary_en: [2025] The team met Mr. Huang, CEO of Kingwhale, a vertically integrated Taiwanese textile and garment company, to understand trends in sustainable textiles and explore downstream collaboration from monomers back to PET textiles. He noted textile-to-textile recycling is a rising trend that may become mandatory but cost is the biggest barrier, advised starting with 100% PET rather than blends, warned of hidden PU and water-resistant coatings, said consumers rarely pay more than 50% extra for sustainability, expressed willingness to collaborate via enzyme licensing or buying recycled monomers, and suggested Fashion for Good as a funding source.
summary_zh: [2025] 團隊與菁華工業（從布料、染整到成衣一條龍的臺灣紡織公司）黃執行長會談，了解永續紡織趨勢並探討從單體回到 PET 布料的下游合作。他指出布對布回收正在興起、未來可能成為法規要求，但成本是最大障礙；建議先處理 100% PET 而非混紡布，提醒 PU、防潑水等隱形塗層問題，並表示即使永續消費者也很少願意多付超過 50%。他願意透過授權酵素或購買再生單體合作，並建議申請 Fashion for Good 的資金。
impact_en: [2025] The team decided to focus on pure PET textiles before PET-cotton blends, emphasised a low-cost scalable solution, repositioned the product commercially toward enzyme licensing or monomer sales to large manufacturers, and placed Kingwhale as the downstream partner in its business model.
impact_zh: [2025] 團隊決定先處理純 PET 布料再挑戰 PET／棉混紡，強調低成本、可放大的解方，並將產品商業定位調整為對大型製造商授權酵素或銷售單體，也在商業模式中將菁華工業列為下游夥伴。

unit_en: Department of Biotechnology and Enzyme Technology
unit_zh: 生物技術與酵素技術系
expertise_en: Enzymatic polyester (PET) degradation; cutinases
expertise_zh: 聚酯（PET）酵素降解；角質酶
summary_en: [2025] The team presented its plan to engineer mutant enzymes for simultaneous cotton-polyester degradation to Prof. Zimmermann. He explained that crystalline PET cannot be degraded without pretreatment (thermal or NaOH), that 45 °C is too low and 60-65 °C is needed, suggested dropping cellulase and processing cotton and PET separately, recommended focusing on polyester and starting with 100% polyester textiles, advised statistical characterisation of mutants, mentioned stronger enzymes (ICCG, PHL7), and said full monomer purification/upcycling exceeds iGEM scope. He supported the team's UV-based real-time monitoring hardware.
summary_zh: [2025] 團隊向 Zimmermann 教授報告以突變酵素同時降解棉／聚酯的計畫。他指出結晶 PET 必須先經熱或 NaOH 前處理才能被酵素分解，45 °C 太低、需 60–65 °C；建議捨棄纖維素酶、將棉與 PET 分開處理，聚焦聚酯並先從 100% 聚酯布開始；建議以統計方式比較突變株，並提到 ICCG、PHL7 等更強的酵素；他也認為完整單體純化／升級再造超出 iGEM 範圍，但肯定團隊以 UV 即時監測酵素效率的硬體。
impact_en: [2025] Narrowed the project focus to polyester degradation, validated the UV-based hardware monitoring approach, and refined the strategy for statistical mutant characterisation and enzyme selection.
impact_zh: [2025] 使團隊將專案聚焦於聚酯降解，肯定以 UV 硬體監測的方式，並修正突變株統計評估與酵素選擇策略。

name_zh: 新北市蘆洲區蘆洲國民小學
organisation_zh: 新北市蘆洲區蘆洲國民小學
expertise_en: Grades 4-6 students (ages 9-12)
expertise_zh: 四至六年級學生（9–12 歲）
summary_en:
[2024] The team taught Grade 3 students a synthetic biology and dengue lesson: DNA, genes and cells explained with toy-block analogies for ATCG, dengue videos and Q&A games on symptoms and prevention, and a DIY DNA bracelet activity (Grade 3 students first did a base-pairing worksheet).
[2025] The team ran the interactive STEM workshop "Enzyme Heroes: Save our clothes!" for grades 4-6: a "Where do clothes go?" icebreaker, fast fashion and textile waste storytelling, a clothes-sorting recycling challenge, DNA/ATCG and enzyme basics, the ATCG & enzyme card game, and upcycling old T-shirts into tote bags, with KAP pre- and post-surveys.
summary_zh:
[2024] 團隊為三年級學生上合成生物學與登革熱課程：以積木比喻ATCG來講解DNA、基因與細胞，搭配登革熱影片與症狀、預防的問答遊戲，並帶學生動手做DNA手環（三年級學生先完成鹼基配對學習單）。
[2025] 團隊為四至六年級學生舉辦互動 STEM 工作坊「酵素英雄：拯救我們的衣服！」，內容包括「衣服去哪了？」破冰、快時尚與紡織廢棄物故事、衣物分類回收挑戰、DNA／ATCG 與酵素入門、ATCG 與酵素卡牌遊戲，以及將舊 T 恤改製成環保袋，並以 KAP 前後測評估。
impact_en:
[2024] Surveys across the four elementary schools: 95% of students clearly understood dengue symptoms, effects and prevention after the lesson (only 7% knew the details before), and 89% said they understood DNA and biology better. The team adjusted its lesson plan between schools.
[2025] Post-surveys showed large knowledge gains (synthetic fibre identification about 40% to 100%, DNA base pairing about 18% to over 90%) and higher willingness to recycle and reuse clothes.
impact_zh:
[2024] 四所國小的課後問卷顯示，95%的學生清楚了解登革熱的症狀、影響與預防（課前僅7%了解細節），89%的學生表示對DNA與生物學更了解。團隊也在各校之間持續調整教案。
[2025] 後測顯示知識明顯提升（辨識人造纖維約 40% 提升至 100%，DNA 鹼基配對約 18% 提升至 90% 以上），回收與重複使用衣物的意願也提高。

expertise_en: Climate-tech venture investment; startup scaling and business strategy
expertise_zh: 氣候科技創投；新創規模化與商業策略
summary_en: [2025] Mr. Yen, Founding Partner at MIH Climate Impact Capital and an investor/advisor to sustainability ventures, consulted with the team more than once. At the very beginning he advised pivoting from general PET plastic degradation to PET textile recycling as an emerging textile-to-textile trend, and later urged the team to focus on its core strength in enzyme innovation rather than trying to control the whole supply chain, highlighting patent protection, targeted partnerships and startup resilience.
summary_zh: [2025] MIH Climate Impact Capital 創始合夥人顏先生是永續新創的投資人與顧問，曾多次與團隊諮詢。專案初期他建議團隊從一般 PET 塑膠降解轉向 PET 紡織品回收，指出布對布回收是新興且迫切的趨勢；之後他再提醒團隊專注於酵素創新這項核心優勢，不要過早試圖掌控整條供應鏈，並強調專利保護、精準合作與新創韌性。
impact_en: [2025] Shaped the project's pivot to textile recycling and the foundation of the entrepreneurship strategy: enzyme development as the key value proposition with partnerships for downstream processing and manufacturing.
impact_zh: [2025] 促成專案轉向紡織品回收，並奠定創業策略基礎：以酵素開發為核心價值主張，下游處理與製造則透過合作完成。

name_zh: 美國國家再生能源實驗室
organisation_zh: 美國國家再生能源實驗室
expertise_en: Enzymatic plastic recycling; polymer upcycling; process design
expertise_zh: 塑膠酵素回收；聚合物升級再造；製程設計
summary_en: [2025] Over Google Meet, Dr. Beckham discussed the technical direction of the PET/cotton degradation project. He said simultaneous PET and cotton degradation in one reactor is unrealistic and recommended a staged PETase-then-cellulase process, advised using commercial cellulase cocktails or Trichoderma reesei (or C. bescii CelA if expressing in-house), stressed pretreatment/amorphisation such as heating followed by rapid quenching, recommended LCC-ICCG and LCC-A2 over TfCut2 (mentioning a low-pH TfCut2 library), and encouraged visible proof-of-concept outputs such as purified TPA and glucose.
summary_zh: [2025] Beckham 博士透過 Google Meet 與團隊討論 PET／棉降解的技術方向。他認為在同一反應槽同時降解 PET 與棉並不實際，建議先以 PETase、再以纖維素酶分段處理；建議使用市售纖維素酶或里氏木黴，如需自行表現可用 C. bescii 的 CelA；強調加熱後快速淬冷等前處理／非晶化的重要性；推薦 LCC-ICCG 與 LCC-A2 優於 TfCut2（並提到低 pH 的 TfCut2 突變庫），並鼓勵以純化 TPA 與葡萄糖等可見成果作為概念驗證。
impact_en: [2025] The team adopted rapid quenching after heating to avoid re-crystallisation, which lowered the crystallinity of the PET film, and refined its design into a staged, implementation-ready process.
impact_zh: [2025] 團隊採用加熱後快速淬冷以避免再結晶，成功降低 PET 薄膜結晶度，並把設計調整為分段、可實作的流程。

unit_en: Department of Biochemical Science and Technology
expertise_en: Microbial biotechnology; enzyme engineering; plastic-degrading microbes
expertise_zh: 微生物生物技術；酵素工程；塑膠分解微生物
summary_en: [2025] The team met Prof. Liu for advice on optimising enzyme activity toward PET and PBAT. He explained that stronger binding does not equal higher catalytic efficiency and can trade off activity between substrates, recommended characterising the wild type first (film degradation, turbidity, monomer release), using p-nitrophenyl butyrate (pNPB) as a quick screening proxy across pH and temperature, noted that temperature optima are rigid while pH is more tunable, and advised structure-guided mutagenesis with colorimetric/fluorescent substrates for high-throughput screening while verifying dual-substrate activity.
summary_zh: [2025] 團隊向劉教授請教如何提升酵素對 PET 與 PBAT 的活性。他說明結合力增強不等於催化效率提升，甚至可能犧牲對另一受質的活性；建議先以薄膜降解、濁度或單體釋放測定野生型基線，並以 p-硝基苯丁酸酯（pNPB）作為快速篩選的替代受質比較不同 pH 與溫度；他指出最適溫度難以改變、pH 則較可調整，並建議以結構導向突變搭配呈色／螢光受質進行高通量篩選，同時確認雙受質活性。
impact_en: [2025] Shaped a systematic workflow: baseline characterisation, structure-guided mutagenesis, and pNPB-based high-throughput screening, with preserved PET/PBAT activity as a mutant-evaluation criterion.
impact_zh: [2025] 建立系統化流程：先做基線測定、再進行結構導向突變與以 pNPB 為主的高通量篩選，並把保留 PET／PBAT 雙活性列為突變株評估標準。

organisation_en: Resource Circulation Administration, Ministry of Environment (RECA)
expertise_en: Textile circularity policy; Taiwan 2050 Net Zero Pathway (Strategy 8: Resource Circulation and Zero Waste)
expertise_zh: 紡織循環政策；臺灣 2050 淨零轉型（關鍵戰略八：資源循環零廢棄）
summary_en: [2025] The team met Section Chief Wu of RECA to understand Taiwan's textile-recycling progress, implementation difficulties and how young innovators can contribute. She explained that textiles are one of ten key sectors under Strategic Action No. 8 of the 2050 Net Zero Pathway, and described initiatives including the Sustainable Fashion Alliance, public-private circular procurement and subsidies for textile identification and recycling technology, the Circular Design Center, and cross-ministerial work with the Ministries of Education and Economic Affairs.
summary_zh: [2025] 團隊拜訪資源循環署吳科長，了解臺灣紡織回收的進展、推動困難以及青年創新者能如何參與。她說明紡織品是 2050 淨零轉型關鍵戰略八（資源循環零廢棄）中的十大重點領域之一，並介紹永續時尚聯盟、公私協力的循環採購與紡織品辨識回收技術補助、循環設計中心，以及與教育部、經濟部的跨部會合作。
impact_en: [2025] Confirmed the project's alignment with national textile-recycling challenges and net-zero strategy, showed the government encourages student circular innovation, and inspired the team to add circular-economy concepts to its education outreach.
impact_zh: [2025] 確認專案方向與國家紡織回收挑戰及淨零策略一致，了解政府鼓勵學生投入循環創新，並啟發團隊將循環經濟概念納入教育推廣。

name_zh: 科研市集（勢得科研股份有限公司）
organisation_zh: 科研市集（勢得科研股份有限公司）
expertise_en: Online marketplace for laboratory equipment and consumables
expertise_zh: 實驗室儀器與耗材線上採購平台
summary_en: [2025] SCIKET sponsored the team by offering a 20% discount on various lab equipment (Attributions form).
summary_zh: [2025] 科研市集以實驗室器材八折優惠贊助團隊（見致謝表）。

name_zh: 新光合成纖維股份有限公司
organisation_zh: 新光合成纖維股份有限公司
expertise_en: Polyester fibre manufacturing; textile recycling; life-cycle and carbon-footprint assessment
expertise_zh: 聚酯纖維製造；紡織品回收；生命週期與碳足跡評估
summary_en: [2025] Team members visited Shinkong Synthetic Fibers (called "New Fibers Textile" / "Xin Qian" on some pages) and heard a technical presentation on the industrial process and the shortcomings of current recycling. The company explained that mechanical recycling damages PET quality and cannot handle blends or coloured/contaminated fabric, that chemical recycling is too energy-intensive for PET-cotton, and that enzymes must cope with semi-crystalline textile-grade PET and remain stable under industrial conditions. They also introduced life-cycle analysis and carbon-footprint accounting as tools to avoid greenwashing.
summary_zh: [2025] 團隊成員參訪新光合成纖維（部分頁面稱為 New Fibers Textile／新纖），聽取技術簡報，了解產業製程與現行回收方式的不足。對方說明機械回收會降低 PET 品質、無法處理混紡或有色／受汙染布料；化學回收用於 PET／棉耗能過高；酵素必須能處理半結晶的紡織級 PET 並在產業條件下保持穩定。他們也介紹以生命週期評估與碳足跡計算避免漂綠。
impact_en: [2025] Confirmed the niche for selective enzymatic recycling of blends, reinforced the team's focus on mutagenesis to improve enzyme durability and efficiency, and led the team to plan LCA/carbon-footprint validation of its system.
impact_zh: [2025] 確認酵素選擇性回收混紡布的利基，強化團隊以突變工程提升酵素耐久度與效率的方向，並使團隊規劃以生命週期評估／碳足跡驗證其系統。

expertise_en: Upcycled denim fashion; ethical employment with cerebral-palsy families and women's associations
expertise_zh: 丹寧升級再造時尚；與腦性麻痺家庭及婦女團體合作的友善就業
summary_en: [2025] Story Wear, a Taiwanese brand upcycling denim and discarded textiles into clothing made by mothers of children with cerebral palsy and women's groups, was the team's main partner for the Dadaocheng sustainability event, which was held at its Dadaocheng store with a Story Wear pop-up booth. The draft HP page records a meeting with manager Alex about supply-chain challenges, corporate partnerships and the team's project: denim comes from donations and mill surplus, removing non-fabric parts is labour-intensive, and blends are costly to process. Proceeds from the team's flea-market booth were donated to support the families of Story Wear's workers.
summary_zh: [2025] Story Wear 是將丹寧與廢棄布料升級再造成服飾、並由腦性麻痺兒家長與婦女團體縫製的臺灣品牌，也是團隊大稻埕永續活動的主要合作夥伴；活動在其大稻埕門市舉行，並設有 Story Wear 快閃攤位。HP 草稿記錄團隊與經理 Alex 會談供應鏈挑戰、企業合作與對專案的看法：丹寧來自捐贈與紡織廠庫存，拆除非布料部件需大量人力，混紡布處理成本高。團隊二手市集攤位的收入也捐出，以支持 Story Wear 員工的家庭。
impact_en: [2025] Hosting the event at Story Wear let visitors see and touch stylish upcycled clothing, which the team used to counter the hygiene/stigma and style barriers found in its street survey; the collaboration also linked the project to an inclusive circular economy.
impact_zh: [2025] 在 Story Wear 舉辦活動讓民眾親眼看到、親手摸到時尚的升級再造服飾，團隊藉此回應街訪中發現的衛生疑慮、污名與款式障礙；此合作也讓專案連結到更具包容性的循環經濟。

name_en: Street-interview respondents and flea-market visitors, Taipei
name_zh: 臺北街頭受訪民眾與二手市集民眾
organisation_en: Street-interview respondents and flea-market visitors, Taipei
organisation_zh: 臺北街頭受訪民眾與二手市集民眾
expertise_en: Consumers' views on second-hand clothing, price and sustainable fashion
expertise_zh: 消費者對二手衣、價格與永續時尚的看法
summary_en: [2025] The team ran qualitative street interviews in Xinyi District, Zhongshan District, Miramar and Ximending, and at a second-hand market where it also sold clothing, asking about social norms, affordability and environmental awareness. Most respondents declined to wear second-hand clothes (hygiene, unfamiliarity), chose clothes mainly by style and price, and over half would pay nothing extra for sustainable items. (The team also ran a separate online KAP survey with 706 respondents.)
summary_zh: [2025] 團隊在信義區、中山區、美麗華與西門町進行質性街訪，也在一個二手市集擺攤賣衣並訪談民眾，問題涵蓋社會規範、負擔能力與環境意識。多數受訪者不願穿二手衣（衛生疑慮、不熟悉），選衣以款式與價格為主，且過半不願為永續商品多付錢。（團隊另以線上 KAP 問卷蒐集 706 份回覆。）
impact_en: [2025] Identified societal, economic and psychological barriers that shaped the Dadaocheng event (held at Story Wear), expert talks, games and education materials.
impact_zh: [2025] 找出社會、經濟與心理障礙，進而影響大稻埕活動（在 Story Wear 舉辦）、專家演講、遊戲與教材的設計。

name_zh: 臺北市立西松高級中學
organisation_zh: 臺北市立西松高級中學
expertise_en: High school students
expertise_zh: 高中生
summary_en: [2025] The team held an outreach session at Xisong High School, co-taught with university students, covering iGEM and synthetic biology, a transcription/translation role-play, a blueberry DNA extraction experiment, university and career sharing, and a Kahoot quiz, with pre- and post-surveys.
summary_zh: [2025] 團隊在西松高中與大學生共同授課，內容包括 iGEM 與合成生物學介紹、轉錄／轉譯角色扮演、藍莓 DNA 萃取實驗、大學生活與生涯分享以及 Kahoot 測驗，並進行前後測。
impact_en: [2025] Moderate impact: gains in core knowledge and willingness to learn synthetic biology and check clothing material; one RNA question declined, prompting the team to revise that content.
impact_zh: [2025] 成效中等：核心知識、學習合成生物學及查看衣物材質的意願有所提升；一題 RNA 題目答對率下降，促使團隊修正該部分內容。

name_zh: 社團法人台灣數位有聲書推展學會
organisation_zh: 社團法人台灣數位有聲書推展學會
unit_en: DAISY Library
expertise_en: Accessible audio content for visually impaired people and students with reading difficulties
expertise_zh: 為視障者與閱讀困難學生提供無障礙有聲內容
summary_en:
[2024] Students at the school for the visually impaired told the team they usually get audiobooks from the DAISY Library and hoped the team's dengue audiobook would be available there. The team contacted the Taiwan Digital Talking Book Association to publish it. According to the iGEM attributions, the association (listed as a sponsor) helped convert the audiobooks into compatible formats and upload them to the DAISY library.
[2025] The team's trilingual (Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese) audiobook on microplastic pollution ("Bubbles and the Deep Blue Garden" / 《小魚逃亡記：微塑膠風波》) was published through TDTB, a non-profit platform giving free audio materials to students with disabilities, reading difficulties or limited access to print. TDTB is listed as a sponsor on the Attributions form.
summary_zh:
[2024] 視障學校的學生告訴團隊，他們平常透過DAISY有聲書圖書館取得有聲書，希望團隊的登革熱有聲書也能放上去。團隊因此聯繫台灣數位有聲書推展學會洽談上架。依iGEM貢獻表記載，該學會（列為贊助單位）協助將有聲書轉成相容格式並上傳到DAISY圖書館。
[2025] 團隊以繁中、英文、日文三語製作的微塑膠有聲書（Bubbles and the Deep Blue Garden／《小魚逃亡記：微塑膠風波》）透過台灣數位有聲書推展學會發行；該會是非營利平台，免費提供有聲資源給身心障礙、閱讀困難或難以取得紙本資料的學生。致謝表將其列為贊助單位。
impact_en:
[2024] The dengue audiobook became accessible to visually impaired readers nationwide through an established platform.
[2025] Made the team's educational content accessible to visually impaired learners and other underserved audiences.
impact_zh:
[2024] 登革熱有聲書透過既有平台，讓全國視障讀者都能取得。
[2025] 讓團隊的教育內容能觸及視障學習者與其他資源不足的族群。

name_zh: 財團法人紡織產業綜合研究所
organisation_zh: 財團法人紡織產業綜合研究所
expertise_en: Textile circularity in Taiwan; industrial textile technology; ISO-based environmental assessment
expertise_zh: 臺灣紡織循環；紡織產業技術；以 ISO 標準進行環境評估
summary_en: [2025] The team interviewed Chief Li Jo-Hwa of TTRI (a government-funded textile research institute) to understand the landscape of textile circularity in Taiwan. She urged the team to quantify environmental impact with ISO standards, to benchmark TfCut2 against enzymes such as LCC and highlight its ability to act on PET and mixed polymers, warned that coatings and finishes (e.g. wrinkle resistance, laminated films) are major recycling barriers, and explained that the spinnability of regenerated PET depends on monomer purity. She also recommended researchers and institutions for further outreach; she is credited as an External Advisor on the Attributions form.
summary_zh: [2025] 團隊訪談紡織所（政府捐助成立的紡織研究機構）李組長，了解臺灣紡織循環的現況。她建議以 ISO 標準量化環境影響、將 TfCut2 與 LCC 等酵素比較並強調其可作用於 PET 與混合聚合物，提醒防皺、貼合膜等塗層與後整理是回收的主要障礙，並說明再生 PET 的可紡性取決於單體純度。她也推薦了可進一步聯繫的研究人員與機構，並在致謝表中列為外部顧問。
impact_en: [2025] Reinforced the need for rigorous (ISO-based) environmental assessment, broadened the enzymatic targets to multiple polymer types, and pushed the team to consider enzyme adaptations for coated or treated textiles.
impact_zh: [2025] 強化團隊進行嚴謹（ISO 標準）環境評估的需求，將酵素目標擴大到多種聚合物，並促使團隊思考如何調整酵素以處理有塗層或經處理的布料。

name_zh: 財團法人紡織產業綜合研究所
title_en: Deputy Director, Department of Raw Materials and Fibers
title_zh: 原料與纖維部門副處長
organisation_zh: 財團法人紡織產業綜合研究所
unit_en: Department of Raw Materials and Fibers
expertise_en: Textile fibres and raw materials; textile recycling routes (physical, chemical, biological); nanocellulose from cotton waste
expertise_zh: 紡織纖維與原料；紡織品回收途徑（物理、化學、生物）；棉廢料製奈米纖維素
summary_en: [2025] The team met Dr. Liang, Deputy Director of TTRI's Department of Raw Materials and Fibers, to discuss PET-cotton blend degradation. He advised that blends should be separated into PET and cotton before processing, that additives such as flame retardants block both chemical and enzymatic recycling, contrasted biological, physical and chemical recycling routes, and pointed out that cotton waste can be valorised as nanocellulose. The Attributions page adds that he supplied fabric samples with defined PET/cotton ratios for lab benchmarking. He later spoke on the expert panel at the team's Dadaocheng sustainability event, explaining why sustainable clothing costs more and the problem of textile overproduction.
summary_zh: [2025] 團隊拜訪紡織所原料與纖維部門副處長梁博士，討論 PET／棉混紡布的降解。他建議混紡布應先分離 PET 與棉再處理，指出阻燃劑等添加物會阻礙化學與酵素回收，比較了生物、物理與化學回收途徑，並提到棉廢料可轉製為奈米纖維素。致謝頁另載明他提供不同 PET／棉比例的布料樣品供實驗室比對。之後他也在團隊於大稻埕舉辦的永續活動座談中擔任講者，說明永續服飾較貴的原因以及衣物過度生產的問題。
impact_en: [2025] Reminded the team to design against industrial benchmarks (consistent purity and durability) and to position the enzyme as one component of a scalable multi-method recycling framework rather than a standalone solution; also highlighted by-product value such as nanocellulose. His public talk was used to address economic and psychological barriers found in the street survey.
impact_zh: [2025] 提醒團隊以產業標準（穩定的純度與耐久度）為設計基準，並把酵素系統定位為可擴大規模之多重回收架構中的一環，而非單獨解方；也讓團隊看到奈米纖維素等副產物的價值。他的公開演講被用來回應街訪中發現的經濟與心理障礙。

expertise_en: Global non-profit on sustainable fibres and materials; circularity reports
expertise_zh: 推動永續纖維與材料的國際非營利組織；循環相關報告
summary_en: [2025] Only in the draft Human Practices document: Textile Exchange shared insights for the project, stressing that major system-level gaps remain in recycling PET/cotton blends, pointing the team to its Future of Synthetics and Scaling Circularity reports, and noting technical limitations and fibre contamination as challenges for enzyme-based recycling. This passage does not appear on the published page.
summary_zh: [2025] 僅見於人類實踐草稿：Textile Exchange 提供意見，強調 PET／棉混紡回收仍有重大系統性缺口，推薦團隊參考其 Future of Synthetics 與 Scaling Circularity 報告，並指出技術限制與纖維汙染是酵素回收的挑戰。此段未出現在正式發布的頁面。

expertise_en: Fair-trade and sustainable fashion; natural materials; recycled sari collections
expertise_zh: 公平貿易與永續時尚；天然材質；回收紗麗系列
summary_en: [2025] The team met Twine (繭裹子), a Taiwanese fair-fashion brand, mainly to invite it to the Dadaocheng public-engagement event. Twine explained that its functional wear uses recycled materials from suppliers such as Singtex rather than in-house recycling, that it sees regeneration as a future direction, and that labour cost and market acceptance are major barriers to large-scale textile recycling. Twine then ran its own pop-up booth selling products at the Dadaocheng sustainability fair.
summary_zh: [2025] 團隊與臺灣公平時尚品牌繭裹子會談，主要是邀請其參加大稻埕的公眾參與活動。繭裹子說明其機能服飾使用興采等供應商的再生材料而非自行回收，視再生為未來方向，並指出人力成本與市場接受度是大規模紡織回收的主要障礙。之後繭裹子在大稻埕永續市集設立快閃攤位販售商品。
impact_en: [2025] Successfully brought Twine into the Dadaocheng event to show the public affordable, durable sustainable products; also taught the team about cost control and communicating sustainability to customers.
impact_zh: [2025] 成功邀請繭裹子參與大稻埕活動，向民眾展示平價耐用的永續商品；也讓團隊了解成本控制與向顧客傳達永續價值的挑戰。

unit_en: Department of Biotechnology and Enzyme Catalysis
unit_zh: 生物技術與酵素催化系
expertise_en: Enzyme engineering; enzymatic PET recycling and polymer degradation
expertise_zh: 酵素工程；PET 酵素回收與聚合物降解
summary_en: [2025] The team presented its enzymatic textile-degradation strategy to Prof. Bornscheuer, who has collaborated with industrial players including Carbios. He suggested replacing TfCut2 with LCC or its variants, warned against a one-pot TfCut2 + cellulase system because of incompatible optima and TPA inhibition of cellulase, proposed degrading PET first and cellulose separately, recommended E. coli SHuffle expression and strong buffers for pH stability, flagged mixing at scale and advised against immobilisation, and urged prioritising physical pretreatment and proof-of-concept results.
summary_zh: [2025] 團隊向曾與 Carbios 等業者合作的 Bornscheuer 教授報告酵素降解布料的策略。他建議以 LCC 或其變異株取代 TfCut2，提醒不要把 TfCut2 與纖維素酶放在同一反應槽（最適條件不同且 TPA 會抑制纖維素酶），建議先降解 PET 再另外處理纖維素；也建議用 E. coli SHuffle 表現並以強緩衝液維持 pH，提醒放大時的混合問題、不建議固定化酵素，並要團隊優先做物理前處理與概念驗證。
impact_en: [2025] Redirected enzyme selection toward industrially relevant candidates, shaped a sequential rather than combined workflow, and brought stability controls and scale-up considerations into the design early, with emphasis on proof-of-concept results.
impact_zh: [2025] 使酵素選擇轉向更具產業意義的候選，流程改為分段而非同槽，並及早納入穩定性控制與放大考量，著重概念驗證成果。

unit_en: Department of Energy, Environmental & Chemical Engineering
unit_zh: 能源、環境與化學工程系
expertise_en: Microbial bioproduction; engineered yeast and cyanobacteria; fermentation; machine learning for strain development
expertise_zh: 微生物生物生產；酵母與藍綠菌工程；發酵；以機器學習優化菌株
summary_en: [2025] In a Google Meet session, Prof. Tang gave feedback on the enzyme-production design and on microbial upcycling of TPA and EG. He warned that enzyme expression is slow and hard to scale, validated CAPCO treatment as a fast PET hydrolysis step, strongly recommended cell-free expression, noted E. coli's double membrane hinders secretion, advised not over-purifying enzymes, suggested testing TfCut and MHETase separately on PET and textiles and checking stability and pretreatment interference, and recommended partnering with teams able to do LCA or cost analyses.
summary_zh: [2025] 唐教授透過 Google Meet 針對酵素生產設計及 TPA、EG 的微生物升級再造提供意見。他提醒酵素表現耗時且難以放大，肯定 CAPCO 處理是快速的 PET 水解方法，強烈建議採用無細胞表現系統，指出大腸桿菌雙層膜不利分泌，建議不要過度純化酵素，並建議分別測試 TfCut 與 MHETase 對 PET 與布料的效果、檢查穩定性與前處理的干擾，也建議與能做生命週期或成本分析的團隊合作。
impact_en: [2025] Prompted the team to consider cell-free expression, reconsider reliance on E. coli hosts, shift toward sequential enzyme testing, and evaluate realistic purification and stability requirements.
impact_zh: [2025] 促使團隊考慮無細胞表現、重新評估對大腸桿菌宿主的依賴，改為分別測試各酵素，並實際評估純化與穩定性需求。

expertise_en: Real estate; community engagement
expertise_zh: 不動產仲介；社區參與
summary_en: [2025] The Education page lists Xinyi Realty, together with Story Wear and Twine, as a collaborator in organising the Dadaocheng sustainability fair featuring interactive booths, DIY workshops and an expert panel on circular fashion. No further details of its role are given.
summary_zh: [2025] 教育頁面列出信義房屋與 Story Wear、繭裹子共同協辦大稻埕永續市集，活動包含互動攤位、DIY 工作坊與循環時尚專家座談。頁面未進一步說明其角色。

name_zh: 新北市瑞芳區義方國民小學
organisation_zh: 新北市瑞芳區義方國民小學
expertise_en: Rural school with fewer than 200 students
expertise_zh: 學生不到 200 人的偏鄉小學
summary_en: [2025] The team visited Yifang Elementary School in rural Ruifang District and taught about 38 fifth- and sixth-grade students about climate change and textile waste. Because the school had no lab, the team used simple demonstrations, interactive presentations and games.
summary_zh: [2025] 團隊前往瑞芳區偏鄉的義方國小，為約 38 名五、六年級學生講授氣候變遷與紡織廢棄物議題。由於學校沒有實驗室，團隊改用簡單示範、互動簡報與遊戲。
impact_en: [2025] Brought climate and textile-waste education to a rural school so rural voices are included.
impact_zh: [2025] 將氣候與紡織廢棄物教育帶到偏鄉學校，讓偏鄉的聲音也能被納入。

name_zh: 新北市立永和國民中學
organisation_zh: 新北市立永和國民中學
expertise_en: Junior high school students
expertise_zh: 國中生
summary_en:
[2024] The team taught Grade 9 students synthetic biology and dengue: a blueberry DNA extraction experiment, CRISPR, BioBricks, PCR, gel electrophoresis and cloning, GM foods and their ethics, dengue and the team's beetroot-geosmin ovitrap with Cyt2Ba, and an introduction to iGEM. The students had already learned some of the material, so the team raised the difficulty for later high school classes.
[2025] In partnership with Yonghe Junior High, the team taught synthetic biology and textile waste through an introduction to iGEM and synbio, a fast-fashion and microplastics discussion, a 5R brainstorming activity, an enzyme lesson with a hands-on potato catalase lab, and a Kahoot quiz, with KAP pre- and post-surveys.
summary_zh:
[2024] 團隊為九年級學生講授合成生物學與登革熱：藍莓DNA萃取實驗、CRISPR、BioBrick、PCR、膠體電泳與基因選殖、基改食品及其倫理議題、登革熱與團隊結合甜菜根土臭素與Cyt2Ba的誘卵器，並介紹iGEM。 部分內容學生已經學過，團隊因此提高了之後高中課程的難度。
[2025] 團隊與永和國中合作，透過 iGEM 與合成生物學介紹、快時尚與微塑膠討論、5R 腦力激盪、酵素課程與馬鈴薯過氧化氫酶實作，以及 Kahoot 測驗教授合成生物學與紡織廢棄物議題，並以 KAP 前後測評估。
impact_en:
[2024] 90% of the junior high and high school students reported a positive impact. Many who were wary of GMOs became curious, and some said they were interested in careers in synthetic biology.
[2025] Knowledge of textile-pollution causes rose from about 10% to 95% and understanding of enzyme activity from about 12% to 100%; some students asked how to join science fairs or iGEM.
impact_zh:
[2024] 90%的國高中學生表示課程對自己有正面影響；許多原本對基改抱持疑慮的學生轉而感到好奇，也有學生表示有興趣投入合成生物學相關職涯。
[2025] 學生對紡織污染成因的理解約由 10% 提升至 95%，對酵素活性的理解約由 12% 提升至 100%；部分學生詢問如何參加科展或 iGEM。

expertise_en: B Corp-certified Taiwanese design brand; sustainable materials; community-based production empowering women
expertise_zh: 獲 B 型企業認證的臺灣設計品牌；永續材料；以社區生產培力女性
summary_en: [2025] The team conducted an in-depth interview with inBlooom, a brand founded in 2008 by three women in Dadaocheng and B Corp certified in 2022, about its business philosophy, sustainable practices, the path to B Corp certification and balancing profitability with social and environmental goals. According to the draft HP page and the Entrepreneurship page, inBlooom also worked with the team at the Dadaocheng community event, jointly hosting activities and information booths on sustainable fashion and community empowerment.
summary_zh: [2025] 團隊深入訪談 2008 年由三位女性在大稻埕創立、2022 年取得 B 型企業認證的品牌印花樂，了解其經營理念、永續做法、取得 B 型企業認證的過程，以及如何兼顧獲利與社會、環境目標。依 HP 草稿與創業頁所述，印花樂也在大稻埕社區活動中與團隊合作，共同舉辦永續時尚與社區培力的活動及資訊攤位。
impact_en: [2025] Turned the enzyme concept into an adoption strategy: prioritise low-cost everyday products, tie governance to B Corp values, partner with NGOs for community empowerment, and set pilot KPIs (test SKUs from monomers, purity/yield, cost vs bottle-rPET, LCA, fair-wage share).
impact_zh: [2025] 將酵素構想轉化為推廣策略：優先發展平價日常產品、以 B 型企業價值治理、與 NGO 合作培力社區，並訂出試點 KPI（以單體製成的測試品項、純度／產率、與瓶回收 rPET 的成本比較、生命週期評估、公平薪資比例）。

expertise_en: Visual design / illustration
expertise_zh: 視覺設計／插畫
summary_en: [2024] Listed in the iGEM attributions as an external collaborator, Charissa helped digitize the wiki homepage design and made it more appealing by working student drawings into the layout.
summary_zh: [2024] iGEM貢獻表將她列為外部合作者。她協助將維基首頁設計數位化，並把學生的繪畫融入版面，讓首頁更吸睛。
impact_en: [2024] She contributed to the visual design of the team wiki homepage.
impact_zh: [2024] 她參與了團隊維基首頁的視覺設計。

title_zh: 科學家、創業家暨投資人
expertise_en: Venture investment; health technology; entrepreneurship
expertise_zh: 創業投資；健康科技；創業
summary_en: [2024] On 17 August 2024 the team met Dr. Wong, a scientist, entrepreneur and investor who has worked on several $1B+ investments and exits, to get feedback on its business model and hardware. She stressed consumer-friendly design (size, looks, instruction manual) and product-market fit before scaling up in developing countries, and suggested making the manual clearer and improving the trap's appearance.
summary_zh: [2024] 2024年8月17日，團隊與曾參與多家十億美元級企業投資與出場的科學家、創業家暨投資人Ling Wong博士會面，請教商業模式與硬體設計。她強調產品要對消費者友善（尺寸、外觀、說明書設計），在開發中國家擴大規模前也要先確認產品與市場契合，並建議把說明書寫得更清楚、改善誘卵器外觀。
impact_en: [2024] The team revised the user manual and made the product more user-friendly and a better market fit.
impact_zh: [2024] 團隊修訂了使用說明書，讓產品更好用，也更貼近市場需求。

title_en: Professor Emeritus; Chief Consultant, National Mosquito-Borne Diseases Control Research Center
title_zh: 名譽教授；國家蚊媒傳染病防治研究中心首席顧問
expertise_en: Medical entomology; mosquito ecology and vector control; dengue prevention
expertise_zh: 醫學昆蟲學；蚊蟲生態與病媒防治；登革熱防治
summary_en: [2024] The team met Prof. Chen before finalizing its topic and interviewed him on 2 July 2024 to present the project idea and get input on its technical direction. He stressed continuous vector-control research and advised on testing the recombinant proteins and sticky ovitrap, suggesting bioassays to prove biolarvicide toxicity. He also referred the team to other mosquito experts, and on 8 August he gave a talk on the application of AI in mosquito control at the team's Dengue Day event, where he praised the project, including Taiwan's first gravitrap.
summary_zh: [2024] 團隊在確定題目前即與陳教授會面，並於2024年7月2日訪談他，說明專題構想並請教技術方向。他強調持續投入病媒防治研究的重要性，針對重組蛋白與黏蚊誘卵器的效果測試提供建議，並建議以多種生物檢定證明生物殺幼蟲劑的毒性。他也為團隊引介其他蚊蟲研究專家，並於8月8日在團隊舉辦的「登革熱日」演講「人工智慧在蚊蟲防治上的應用」，肯定本專題的可行性，以及團隊做出的臺灣首個誘殺產卵桶（gravitrap）。
impact_en: [2024] His advice shaped the team's research direction and the bioassays used to validate the recombinant biolarvicidal proteins and the sticky ovitrap. His Dengue Day talk added expert content to the team's public education.
impact_zh: [2024] 他的建議影響了團隊的研究方向，也決定了用來驗證重組生物殺幼蟲蛋白與黏蚊誘卵器的生物檢定。他在登革熱日的演講則為團隊的公眾教育增添專業內容。

expertise_en: Biotech services (mass spectrometry, extracellular vesicles, protein assays); bio-entrepreneurship
expertise_zh: 生技研究服務（質譜、胞外囊泡、蛋白質分析）；生技創業
summary_en: [2024] On 5 July 2024 the team asked Mr. Kong, CEO of the Malaysian biotech company Cytomics, how to get stakeholders to invest in its product, how to promote biotech products, and about pest control in Taiwan. He said to first identify the problem and the demand for a solution, that the product has to be affordable (lower cost while keeping performance), and that countries where dengue is more common could be the main market.
summary_zh: [2024] 2024年7月5日，團隊請教馬來西亞生技公司Cytomics執行長Kong先生，如何說服利害關係人投資產品、如何推廣生技產品，以及臺灣的病媒防治情況。他指出應先釐清問題本身與市場需求，產品必須價格親民（壓低成本並維持效能），也可將登革熱較普遍的國家當作主要市場。
impact_en: [2024] The team decided to redesign its ovitrap to cut costs before promoting it, and later created the low-cost Pennytrap.
impact_zh: [2024] 團隊決定先重新設計誘卵器以降低成本再對外推廣，之後也發展出低成本的Pennytrap。

expertise_en: Insecticide R&D and commercialization; vector control products; marketing
expertise_zh: 殺蟲劑研發與商品化；病媒防治產品；行銷
summary_en: [2024] On 4 July 2024 the team talked with Ms. Chan, R&D General Manager at the multinational insecticide maker Fumakilla Malaysia, about ovitrap design, vector control, marketing and a customer-centred view of the product, including field use of the recombinant proteins as larvicides. She said the synbio system and its hardware must be user-friendly to sell.
