She walked the team through insecticide R&D from bench to market: running proper biolarvicidal assays, registering compounds with local regulators, doing market surveys, and educating consumers.
summary_zh: [2024] 2024年7月4日，團隊與跨國殺蟲劑製造商Fumakilla馬來西亞公司研發部總經理Chan女士討論誘卵器設計、病媒防治、行銷，以及以顧客為中心的產品思維，也談到將重組蛋白當作殺幼蟲劑實際使用的潛力。她指出，合成生物系統與硬體必須容易使用才賣得出去。她也說明殺蟲劑從實驗室到上市的研發流程：確實進行生物殺幼蟲試驗、向當地主管機關登記化合物、做市場調查，以及教育消費者。
impact_en: [2024] The team wrote a detailed instruction manual for the Beeter Trap and a usage guide for MosBeeter, and discussed marketing the product in dengue-endemic countries in its entrepreneurship plan.
impact_zh: [2024] 團隊為Beeter Trap撰寫詳細使用說明書，也為MosBeeter編寫使用指南，並在創業計畫中討論將產品推向登革熱流行國家。

name_zh: 居家試用志願者（臺北市）
organisation_zh: 居家試用志願者（臺北市）
expertise_en: End users of the sticky ovitrap
expertise_zh: 黏蚊誘卵器的終端使用者
summary_en: [2024] Of 342 respondents to the team's general hardware questionnaire, 84 agreed to a one-week home trial of Prototype 2 (without biolarvicidal proteins). The team confirmed 10 volunteers across Taipei, each testing for a week between 3 August and 28 September; with team members' households and consenting relatives, there were 40 participants. Each got the trap, sticky paper and a manual, and was randomly assigned to use water only or water with beetroot peel powder, then answered a follow-up survey.
summary_zh: [2024] 在團隊硬體問卷的342份回覆中，有84人同意在家試用第二代原型（不含生物殺幼蟲蛋白）一週。團隊最後確認臺北市各區10位志願者，於8月3日至9月28日間各試用一週；加上團隊成員家中及同意參與的親友，共有40位參與者。每人都拿到誘卵器、黏蚊紙與說明書，並隨機分為只加水組與加甜菜根皮粉組，試用後填寫回饋問卷。
impact_en: [2024] Trial users mostly commented on the trap's appearance. Together with the survey results (size, manual clarity, acceptable price under NT$800), this feedback led to the 3D-printed Prototype 3 and a revised manual.
impact_zh: [2024] 試用者的意見多集中在誘卵器外觀；這些回饋加上問卷結果（尺寸、說明書是否清楚、可接受價格在800元以下），促成了3D列印的第三代原型與修訂版說明書。

summary_en: [2024] The team taught preschoolers about dengue by reading the CDC children's story "Kiki Fights Dengue Fever", playing a dengue vocabulary card game (slap the mosquito card, read the word cards aloud), and having the children color mosquitoes while learning the features of Aedes mosquitoes. The card sets were left with the kindergarten teachers for review in later lessons.
summary_zh: [2024] 團隊為幼兒園孩童上登革熱課程：朗讀疾管署童書《奇奇對抗登革熱》、玩登革熱英文單字卡牌遊戲（看到蚊子卡就拍、看到單字卡就唸出來），並讓孩子一邊認識斑蚊特徵一邊替蚊子著色。卡牌留給幼兒園老師，供日後複習使用。
impact_en: [2024] The children learned to tell Aedes mosquitoes apart from other mosquitoes, which responds to the survey finding that many people don't know Aedes carries dengue. Teachers kept the card game as a review tool.
impact_zh: [2024] 孩子們學會分辨斑蚊與其他蚊子，回應了問卷中許多民眾不知道斑蚊會傳播登革熱的結果；老師也保留卡牌遊戲作為複習工具。

title_en: Professor & Associate Dean, College of Public Health
title_zh: 教授兼公共衛生學院副院長
unit_en: College of Public Health, Institute of Environmental and Occupational Health Sciences
unit_zh: 公共衛生學院 環境與職業健康科學研究所
expertise_en: Medical entomology; vector control; vector-borne diseases; public health
expertise_zh: 醫學昆蟲學；病媒管制；蟲媒傳染病；公共衛生
summary_en: [2024] On 2 July 2024 the team presented its research plan, aims and challenges to Prof. Tsai and asked him about the project's technical side. He talked about medical entomology research and the future of synthetic biology in Taiwan, and advised on research design, including comparing experimental and control groups and setting clear variables and constants. According to the iGEM attributions, he also supplied resources for the lab work: team members went to NTU to pick up mosquitoes, and the oviposition assays used an NTU College of Public Health Aedes albopictus lab strain. On 8 August he spoke on eco-friendly approaches to dengue control at Dengue Day.
summary_zh: [2024] 2024年7月2日，團隊向蔡教授說明研究計畫、目標與遇到的困難，並請教專題的技術面。他分享了醫學昆蟲學研究與臺灣合成生物學的未來發展，並就研究設計給予建議，包括比較實驗組與對照組、設定明確的變因與常數。依iGEM貢獻表記載，他也提供實驗所需資源：團隊成員到臺大領取蚊子，產卵試驗使用的是臺大公衛學院的白線斑蚊實驗室品系。8月8日，他在登革熱日演講「友善環境的登革熱防治方法」。
impact_en: [2024] His advice made the team's experimental design more rigorous (control groups, defined variables), and the mosquitoes his group supplied made the beetroot oviposition and ovitrap functional assays possible. The journal club also discussed his view that AI could be built into ovitraps.
impact_zh: [2024] 他的建議讓實驗設計更嚴謹（設置對照組、明確定義變因），他的研究團隊提供的蚊子則讓甜菜根產卵試驗與誘卵器功能試驗得以進行。期刊討論會也探討了他認為可在誘卵器中導入AI的看法。

summary_en: [2024] The team taught visually impaired students about DNA, genes, plasmids and recombinant DNA technology and introduced its dengue project. Students used touch: a double-helix model, a clay plasmid model with a swappable insert, and the gravitrap prototypes. The team also used its audiobook and braille comic book. A Q&A and feedback session followed, and students suggested making the audiobook available through the DAISY Library.
summary_zh: [2024] 團隊為視障學生講解DNA、基因、質體與重組DNA技術，並介紹登革熱專題。學生透過觸覺學習：雙股螺旋模型、可替換片段的黏土質體模型，以及誘殺產卵桶原型。團隊也使用自製的有聲書與點字漫畫。課後的問答與回饋時間中，學生建議將有聲書放上DAISY有聲書圖書館。
impact_en: [2024] Student feedback led the team to contact the Taiwan Digital Talking Book Association and put its audiobook on the DAISY Library. The team also plans to work with a braille printing company to produce more braille comic books.
impact_zh: [2024] 學生的回饋促使團隊聯繫台灣數位有聲書推展學會，將有聲書上架到DAISY圖書館；團隊也計畫與點字印刷公司合作，印製更多點字漫畫。

expertise_en: iGEM high-school team; Cantonese translation
expertise_zh: iGEM高中隊伍；粵語翻譯
summary_en: [2024] As part of reaching out to other iGEM teams, GEMS Taiwan sent the English version of its dengue audiobook to team HKSSC and asked them to translate it into Cantonese. The Cantonese version is on the GEMS_Taiwan YouTube channel.
summary_zh: [2024] GEMS Taiwan在主動聯繫其他iGEM隊伍時，將登革熱有聲書的英文版寄給HKSSC隊，請他們翻譯成粵語。粵語版已上架至GEMS_Taiwan的YouTube頻道。
impact_en: [2024] The audiobook now reaches Cantonese speakers, and the collaboration strengthened ties within the iGEM community.
impact_zh: [2024] 有聲書因此能觸及粵語使用者，也加深了與iGEM社群的連結。

title_en: Professor of Pediatrics and of Health Policy; Director, Center for Policy, Outcomes and Prevention
title_zh: 兒科與衛生政策教授；政策、成果與預防中心主任
unit_en: Center for Policy, Outcomes and Prevention (CPOP)
expertise_en: Pandemic preparedness; health policy; healthcare value and delivery innovation
expertise_zh: 大流行防範；衛生政策；醫療價值與照護創新
summary_en: [2024] On 2 August 2024 the team asked Prof. Wang how to implement the project globally and why it matters there. He said that to help dengue-affected countries beyond Taiwan, the team must lower the production cost of its synbio and hardware system. He pointed them to Stanford's Design for Extreme Affordability course and asked them to apply its ideas to Dengue Beeters.
summary_zh: [2024] 2024年8月2日，團隊請教王智弘教授，如何在全球推動本專題以及其意義。他指出，若要幫助臺灣以外受登革熱影響的國家，必須降低合成生物系統與硬體的生產成本。他向團隊介紹史丹佛的「極致平價設計」（Design for Extreme Affordability）課程，請團隊將其理念應用在Dengue Beeters上。
impact_en: [2024] The team developed the Pennytrap, a low-cost gravid trap for underdeveloped and dengue-endemic countries, and reworked Prototype 3 around cost-effectiveness.
impact_zh: [2024] 團隊開發出適用於低度開發與登革熱流行國家的低成本誘蚊產卵器Pennytrap，並以成本效益為核心改良第三代原型。

title_zh: 教授（重組DNA選殖技術先驅）
unit_en: School of Medicine, Department of Genetics
expertise_en: Recombinant DNA; gene cloning; genetic engineering
expertise_zh: 重組DNA；基因選殖；基因工程
summary_en: [2024] On 11 July 2024 the team interviewed Prof. Cohen, who with Herbert Boyer first cloned DNA and moved genes between organisms, about the project concept, especially larvicidal toxins in a chromosome-free system. The team had started experiments in June and could not get the right sequence after transformation. He helped troubleshoot the procedures, shared cloning techniques and experience, and discussed why the project uses a chromosome-free system. The team also asked him how to teach the public about genetic engineering and about safety concerns in cloning.
summary_zh: [2024] 2024年7月11日，團隊訪談了與Herbert Boyer共同完成首次DNA選殖、將基因轉移至另一種生物的Cohen教授，請教專題構想，特別是在無染色體系統中表現殺幼蟲毒素的做法。團隊6月開始實驗，轉形後一直無法得到正確序列。他協助排查實驗流程，分享選殖技術與經驗，並討論專題使用無染色體系統的原因。團隊也請教他如何向大眾推廣基因工程知識，以及選殖時的安全考量。
impact_en: [2024] His troubleshooting helped the wet lab fix its cloning and transformation problems and firm up the chromosome-free system approach.
impact_zh: [2024] 他的排錯建議幫助濕實驗組解決選殖與轉形問題，也讓團隊更確定採用無染色體系統的做法。

expertise_en: Synthetic biology entrepreneurship; molecular biology; bio-startup ecosystem
expertise_zh: 合成生物學創業；分子生物學；生技新創生態系
summary_en: [2024] On 6 July 2024 the team interviewed John Cumbers, molecular biologist and founder/CEO of SynBioBeta, to learn how to model the business and start a business plan. According to the attributions, he also visited the team's workspace and lab in July and gave a talk on current trends in synthetic biology. He suggested using pest-control companies as a distribution channel, charging them a subscription, offering paid trap maintenance, looking at other markets such as camping, drawing business model canvases for customers and pest-control companies, and collecting data to test assumptions and de-risk the company.
summary_zh: [2024] 2024年7月6日，團隊訪談分子生物學家、SynBioBeta創辦人暨執行長John Cumbers，請教如何建立商業模式、著手撰寫商業計畫。依貢獻表記載，他7月也親自參訪團隊的工作空間與實驗室，並演講合成生物學的最新趨勢。他建議以既有的除蟲公司作為通路、向其收取訂閱費、提供付費的誘卵器維護服務、開發露營等其他市場、分別為消費者與除蟲公司繪製商業模式圖，並蒐集數據驗證假設以降低創業風險。
impact_en: [2024] The entrepreneurship plan names pest-control companies as partners, includes a subscription and maintenance service model, and was built with a business model canvas.
impact_zh: [2024] 創業計畫將除蟲公司列為合作夥伴，加入訂閱與維護服務模式，並以商業模式圖建構。

name_en: Taipei City Da'an District Da'an Elementary School
name_zh: 臺北市大安區大安國民小學
organisation_en: Taipei City Da'an District Da'an Elementary School
organisation_zh: 臺北市大安區大安國民小學
summary_en: [2024] The team taught Grade 3 students a synthetic biology and dengue lesson: DNA, genes and cells explained with toy-block analogies for ATCG, dengue videos and Q&A games on symptoms and prevention, and a DIY DNA bracelet activity (Grade 3 students first did a base-pairing worksheet).
summary_zh: [2024] 團隊為三年級學生上合成生物學與登革熱課程：以積木比喻ATCG來講解DNA、基因與細胞，搭配登革熱影片與症狀、預防的問答遊戲，並帶學生動手做DNA手環（三年級學生先完成鹼基配對學習單）。
impact_en: [2024] Surveys across the four elementary schools: 95% of students clearly understood dengue symptoms, effects and prevention after the lesson (only 7% knew the details before), and 89% said they understood DNA and biology better. The team adjusted its lesson plan between schools.
impact_zh: [2024] 四所國小的課後問卷顯示，95%的學生清楚了解登革熱的症狀、影響與預防（課前僅7%了解細節），89%的學生表示對DNA與生物學更了解。團隊也在各校之間持續調整教案。

name_en: Taipei City Xinyi District Fude Elementary School
name_zh: 臺北市信義區福德國民小學
organisation_en: Taipei City Xinyi District Fude Elementary School
organisation_zh: 臺北市信義區福德國民小學
summary_en: [2024] The team taught Grade 5 students a synthetic biology and dengue lesson: DNA, genes and cells explained with toy-block analogies for ATCG, dengue videos and Q&A games on symptoms and prevention, and a DIY DNA bracelet activity (Grade 3 students first did a base-pairing worksheet). The adjustable knots used here were too hard for the students to tie, so the team switched to elastic thread for later schools.
summary_zh: [2024] 團隊為五年級學生上合成生物學與登革熱課程：以積木比喻ATCG來講解DNA、基因與細胞，搭配登革熱影片與症狀、預防的問答遊戲，並帶學生動手做DNA手環（三年級學生先完成鹼基配對學習單）。 由於這次使用的活結對學生來說太難綁，團隊之後到其他學校改用彈性線。
impact_en: [2024] Surveys across the four elementary schools: 95% of students clearly understood dengue symptoms, effects and prevention after the lesson (only 7% knew the details before), and 89% said they understood DNA and biology better. The team adjusted its lesson plan between schools.
impact_zh: [2024] 四所國小的課後問卷顯示，95%的學生清楚了解登革熱的症狀、影響與預防（課前僅7%了解細節），89%的學生表示對DNA與生物學更了解。團隊也在各校之間持續調整教案。

name_en: Taipei City Xinyi District Xing Ya Elementary School
name_zh: 臺北市信義區興雅國民小學
organisation_en: Taipei City Xinyi District Xing Ya Elementary School
organisation_zh: 臺北市信義區興雅國民小學
summary_en: [2024] The team taught Grade 3–6 students a synthetic biology and dengue lesson: DNA, genes and cells explained with toy-block analogies for ATCG, dengue videos and Q&A games on symptoms and prevention, and a DIY DNA bracelet activity (Grade 3 students first did a base-pairing worksheet). Learning from Fude Elementary, the team used elastic thread here so the bracelets were easier to make.
summary_zh: [2024] 團隊為三至六年級學生上合成生物學與登革熱課程：以積木比喻ATCG來講解DNA、基因與細胞，搭配登革熱影片與症狀、預防的問答遊戲，並帶學生動手做DNA手環（三年級學生先完成鹼基配對學習單）。 團隊記取在福德國小的經驗，這次改用彈性線，讓手環更容易製作。
impact_en: [2024] Surveys across the four elementary schools: 95% of students clearly understood dengue symptoms, effects and prevention after the lesson (only 7% knew the details before), and 89% said they understood DNA and biology better. The team adjusted its lesson plan between schools.
impact_zh: [2024] 四所國小的課後問卷顯示，95%的學生清楚了解登革熱的症狀、影響與預防（課前僅7%了解細節），89%的學生表示對DNA與生物學更了解。團隊也在各校之間持續調整教案。

name_en: Taipei Municipal Yucheng Senior High School
name_zh: 臺北市立育成高級中學
organisation_en: Taipei Municipal Yucheng Senior High School
organisation_zh: 臺北市立育成高級中學
summary_en: [2024] The team taught Grade 10–12 students synthetic biology and dengue: a blueberry DNA extraction experiment, CRISPR, BioBricks, PCR, gel electrophoresis and cloning, GM foods and their ethics, dengue and the team's beetroot-geosmin ovitrap with Cyt2Ba, and an introduction to iGEM. The lesson was made harder based on the Yonghe Junior High experience.
summary_zh: [2024] 團隊為高一至高三學生講授合成生物學與登革熱：藍莓DNA萃取實驗、CRISPR、BioBrick、PCR、膠體電泳與基因選殖、基改食品及其倫理議題、登革熱與團隊結合甜菜根土臭素與Cyt2Ba的誘卵器，並介紹iGEM。 團隊根據在永和國中的經驗調高了課程難度。
impact_en: [2024] 90% of the junior high and high school students reported a positive impact. Many who were wary of GMOs became curious, and some said they were interested in careers in synthetic biology.
impact_zh: [2024] 90%的國高中學生表示課程對自己有正面影響；許多原本對基改抱持疑慮的學生轉而感到好奇，也有學生表示有興趣投入合成生物學相關職涯。

name_en: Taiwan Centers for Disease Control, Ministry of Health and Welfare
name_zh: 衛生福利部疾病管制署
organisation_en: Taiwan Centers for Disease Control, Ministry of Health and Welfare
organisation_zh: 衛生福利部疾病管制署
expertise_en: National dengue prevention policy, surveillance and outbreak response
expertise_zh: 全國登革熱防治政策、監測與疫情應變
summary_en: [2024] The team met Taiwan CDC to learn about current dengue prevention strategies, challenges and possible collaboration. CDC described seasonal measures (May–November): removing standing water, TOCC history-taking by doctors, NS1 rapid tests, spraying in case areas, and tracking imported cases. It also described its dengue risk map, ovitrap trials with the National Mosquito-Borne Diseases Control Research Center in Tainan and Kaohsiung, international data sharing (Singapore, Japan, APEC), and community outreach. CDC said the trap design fits its strategy.
summary_zh: [2024] 團隊拜訪疾病管制署，了解現行登革熱防治策略、面臨的挑戰與可能的合作方向。疾管署說明5月至11月的主要措施：清除積水容器、醫師詢問TOCC病史、NS1快篩、病例區噴藥，以及追蹤境外移入病例。疾管署也介紹登革熱風險地圖、與國家蚊媒傳染病防治研究中心在臺南、高雄試行誘卵器監測、與新加坡、日本及APEC的國際資料交流，以及社區宣導做法，並認為團隊的誘卵器設計符合其防治策略。
impact_en: [2024] CDC suggested working with the National Mosquito-Borne Diseases Control Research Center to place traps in hot spots, adding local languages on social media, and evaluating traps in high-risk areas such as Kaohsiung. This led the team to put local schools and communities first.
impact_zh: [2024] 疾管署建議與國家蚊媒傳染病防治研究中心合作，在熱區布放誘卵器、在社群媒體加入在地語言，並到高雄等高風險地區評估誘卵器成效。團隊因此決定優先深耕在地學校與社區。

expertise_en: Integrated vector management (larviciding, source reduction) for malaria and dengue in crisis settings
expertise_zh: 危機地區瘧疾與登革熱的整合性病媒管理（殺幼蟲、孳生源清除）
summary_en: [2024] On 2 August 2024 the team asked Mr. Gonçalo, a field entomologist at The MENTOR Initiative (an NGO doing vector control in countries such as Angola, Mozambique, Nigeria, South Sudan and Venezuela), for feedback on the Beeter Trap and whether Dengue Beeters could scale. He described vector control in underdeveloped countries and urged eco-friendly, reusable, long-lasting materials to avoid plastic waste. He also recommended convenient, low-maintenance products and said recombinant larvicides will need more synthetic biology education.
summary_zh: [2024] 2024年8月2日，團隊請教The MENTOR Initiative（在安哥拉、莫三比克、奈及利亞、南蘇丹、委內瑞拉等國從事病媒防治的非政府組織）的田野昆蟲學家Gonçalo先生，對Beeter Trap的意見以及Dengue Beeters能否擴大規模。他分享在低度開發國家實地執行病媒防治的經驗，強調材料要環保、可重複使用且耐久，避免產生塑膠垃圾。他也建議產品要方便、少維護，並指出重組殺幼蟲劑的推廣需要更多合成生物學教育。
impact_en: [2024] The team decided to use beetroot peels from food waste and recycled plastics for the Pennytrap, focused Prototype 3 on sustainability, and did more synthetic biology education (e.g., Dengue Day).
impact_zh: [2024] 團隊決定以食物廢棄物中的甜菜根皮與回收塑膠製作Pennytrap，第三代原型以永續性為重點，並加強合成生物學教育（例如登革熱日）。

unit_en: Tropical Infectious Diseases Research & Education Centre (TIDREC)
unit_zh: 熱帶傳染病研究與教育中心（TIDREC）
expertise_en: Dengue; vector control; insecticide resistance; tropical medicine
expertise_zh: 登革熱；病媒防治；殺蟲劑抗藥性；熱帶醫學
summary_en: [2024] On 18 July 2024 the team asked Assoc. Prof. Low, who sits on the Malaysian Ministry of Health's Technical Working Committee for Insecticide Resistance, about the practicality, research design and execution of its recombinant biolarvicidal protein project. He stressed cost-effectiveness, communication and the biosafety of the proteins. He suggested WHO-standard oviposition assays with different concentrations of beetroot peel powder and recombinant toxins, and the group discussed the biosafety of using recombinant proteins in the field.
summary_zh: [2024] 2024年7月18日，團隊請教Low Van Lun副教授——他是馬來西亞衛生部殺蟲劑抗藥性技術工作委員會成員——本專題重組生物殺幼蟲蛋白的可行性、研究設計與執行方式。他強調成本效益、溝通與蛋白質生物安全的重要性，建議以不同濃度的甜菜根皮粉與重組毒素進行WHO標準產卵試驗，雙方也討論了重組蛋白實際用於野外時的生物安全問題。
impact_en: [2024] The team learned it had to synthesize the recombinant proteins and test them thoroughly in vitro and in vivo, and it planned oviposition assays across a range of beetroot peel powder concentrations.
impact_zh: [2024] 團隊了解到必須先合成重組蛋白，並進行完整的體外與體內測試，也據此規劃了不同甜菜根皮粉濃度的產卵試驗。

title_zh: 醫學與法醫昆蟲學研究者
unit_en: Institute of Biological Sciences, Faculty of Science
unit_zh: 理學院 生物科學研究所
expertise_en: Medical and forensic entomology; ovitrap surveillance; insecticide resistance; dengue KAP studies
expertise_zh: 醫學與法醫昆蟲學；誘卵器監測；殺蟲劑抗藥性；登革熱知識、態度與行為研究
summary_en: [2024] In an online interview on 5 July 2024, Dr. Chen discussed insect science, insecticide resistance, mosquito bionomics and public awareness of mosquito-borne diseases, and presented a gravitrap starter packet. He noted that catching one female mosquito is like catching about 200 more, because each can lay about 200 eggs. He advised the team to find out how often users should change the water and pellets, to show statistically that their trap works better than traps already on the market, and to write a clear illustrated manual that stresses the trap is non-toxic.
summary_zh: [2024] 在2024年7月5日的線上訪談中，陳博士與團隊討論昆蟲學、殺蟲劑抗藥性、蚊蟲生物學與民眾對蚊媒疾病的認知，並簡報了誘殺產卵桶入門資料。他指出，捕到一隻雌蚊就等於少了約200隻蚊子，因為每隻雌蚊可產下約200顆卵。他建議團隊找出使用者應多久更換水與誘餌顆粒、以統計數據證明本產品比市售誘蚊器更有效，並製作附圖的清楚說明書，強調產品無毒。
impact_en: [2024] The team kept sticky paper on the inner wall of the ovitrap, added statistical validation and water/pellet replacement tests to its plans, and wrote a detailed instruction manual that emphasizes the trap is non-toxic.
impact_zh: [2024] 團隊決定保留誘卵器內壁的黏蚊紙設計，將統計驗證與換水／更換誘餌的測試納入規劃，並撰寫強調產品無毒的詳細使用說明書。

title_en: Professor; PI of the Bacterial Pesticidal Protein Resource Center
title_zh: 教授；細菌殺蟲蛋白資源中心（Pesticidal Proteins網站）主要研究者
unit_en: School of Life Sciences
expertise_en: Bacillus thuringiensis and bacterial pesticidal proteins; protein nomenclature
expertise_zh: 蘇雲金芽孢桿菌與細菌殺蟲蛋白；殺蟲蛋白命名
summary_en: [2024] While designing composite biolarvicidal constructs, the team found the 'Pesticidal Proteins' website and contacted Prof. Crickmore, one of its main investigators. He replied about the prospects and challenges of synthetic biolarvicides and helped troubleshoot the team's technical problems, sharing tips on assembly, ribosome binding site (RBS) and linker sequences, and cloning techniques.
summary_zh: [2024] 團隊在設計複合生物殺幼蟲蛋白構築體時發現「Pesticidal Proteins」網站，並聯繫網站主要研究者之一Crickmore教授。他回覆說明合成生物殺幼蟲劑的前景與挑戰，也協助排解團隊遇到的技術問題，分享片段組裝的訣竅、核糖體結合位（RBS）與連接子序列，以及選殖技術。
impact_en: [2024] With his advice the team learned how to link two or three fragments, chose the strong RBS BBa_B0030, and designed composites such as p20-Cyt2Ba-Xpp81Aa1.
impact_zh: [2024] 在他的建議下，團隊學會如何連接二至三個基因片段，選用強效RBS BBa_B0030，並設計出p20-Cyt2Ba-Xpp81Aa1等複合構築體。

name_zh: 緯謙科技股份有限公司
organisation_zh: 緯謙科技股份有限公司
expertise_en: Cloud, data and AI solutions; AI Dengue Fever Prevention Platform (AI mosquito-egg counting and Aedes larva identification)
expertise_zh: 雲端、數據與AI解決方案；AI登革熱防疫平台（AI計數蚊卵與辨識斑蚊幼蟲）
summary_en: [2024] On 7 August 2024 the team met WiAdvance, a Wistron subsidiary and Microsoft partner, to discuss a possible collaboration and learn about its AI Dengue Fever Prevention Platform. The 1.5-year project collects images, many taken by the public, and uses AI to count mosquito eggs and identify Aedes larvae, reaching 95% accuracy. WiAdvance suggested looking at Southeast Asia as a market, collecting more pictures to improve the team's photo detector, finding ways to get households to buy the product, and integrating AI.
summary_zh: [2024] 2024年8月7日，團隊拜訪緯創子公司、微軟合作夥伴緯謙科技，洽談合作可能並了解其「AI登革熱防疫平台」。該計畫歷時一年半，蒐集大量影像（許多由民眾拍攝），以AI計數蚊卵並辨識是否為斑蚊幼蟲，準確率達95%。緯謙建議團隊把東南亞列為可開發的市場、蒐集更多照片以提升影像辨識準確度、設法吸引家庭用戶購買，並導入AI。
impact_en: [2024] The meeting encouraged the team to build AI into its product and to develop its own mosquito egg-counting software.
impact_zh: [2024] 這次交流促使團隊將AI導入產品，並自行開發蚊卵計數軟體。

unit_en: Health Emergencies Programme – Emerging Zoonotic Diseases, Arboviruses team
unit_zh: 衛生緊急計畫－新興人畜共通疾病部門 蟲媒病毒團隊
expertise_en: Infectious disease epidemiology; arboviruses (dengue); global health programmes
expertise_zh: 傳染病流行病學；蟲媒病毒（登革熱）；全球衛生計畫
summary_en: [2024] On 30 August 2024 the team asked Dr. Rojas Alvarez, a medical doctor and epidemiologist leading WHO's arbovirus team, for feedback on the project and on engaging NGOs to promote it globally. She said the Pennytrap would help underprivileged areas and advised starting in local communities, testing in socioeconomically similar areas, and mapping partners once efficacy and cost-effectiveness were proven. She also suggested filming a Pennytrap construction video, having children bring recyclables to build traps, measuring impact through dengue-related school absences, pitching to WHO's TDR programme, and approaching local NGOs before international ones.
summary_zh: [2024] 2024年8月30日，團隊請教身為醫師、流行病學家並負責WHO蟲媒病毒團隊的Rojas Alvarez博士，對專題的意見以及如何與非政府組織合作、在全球推廣。她認為Pennytrap對弱勢地區很有幫助，建議先從在地社區做起、在社經條件相近的地區測試，並在證明效果與成本效益後盤點潛在夥伴。她也建議拍攝Pennytrap製作教學影片、讓孩童帶回收物來製作誘蚊器、以登革熱相關的學生缺課情形評估成效、向WHO的TDR計畫提案，並先與在地NGO合作再尋求國際NGO。
impact_en: [2024] The team made a Pennytrap video tutorial, contacted NGOs to test the product, and strengthened its local school and community outreach.
impact_zh: [2024] 團隊製作了Pennytrap教學影片、聯繫NGO測試產品，並加強在地學校與社區推廣。

expertise_en: Web development; front-end animation and debugging
expertise_zh: 網頁開發；前端動畫與除錯
summary_en: [2023] Listed on the iGEM attribution form as an external advisor from industry who guided the software team on fine-tuning the home-page parallax animation and the member-page slider, helped with debugging, and mediated communication between the software team and other members.
summary_zh: [2023] iGEM 貢獻表將其列為業界外部顧問：指導軟體組調整首頁視差動畫與成員頁滑動效果、協助除錯，並協調軟體組與其他成員之間的溝通。

title_en: Research Fellow and Deputy Director, Biodiversity Research Center
title_zh: 研究員兼生物多樣性研究中心副主任
unit_en: Biodiversity Research Center – Marine Microbial Ecology Lab
unit_zh: 生物多樣性研究中心 海洋微生物生態實驗室
expertise_en: Marine microbial ecology; coral reef microbes; microbial genomics and metagenomics; computational microbiology
expertise_zh: 海洋微生物生態；珊瑚礁微生物；微生物基因體與總體基因體學；計算微生物學
summary_en: [2023] The team met Dr. Tang in person to assess the feasibility of their probiotic delivery method. He pointed out that corals do not absorb external substances through their exoskeletons and that they secrete protective mucus, endorsed using AI-driven robots to deliver the product to coral colonies, and raised ethical concerns about releasing GMOs into the ocean. The team also consulted him on where to begin researching GMO regulations, and he approved their quorum-sensing kill-switch biosafety design.
summary_zh: [2023] 團隊與湯森林老師實體會面，評估益生菌遞送方式的可行性。他指出珊瑚不會透過外骨骼吸收外部物質，且會分泌保護性黏液；他支持以 AI 驅動的機器人將產品精準遞送至珊瑚群落，並提出在海洋中釋放基因改造生物的倫理疑慮。團隊也向他請教 GMO 法規研究的切入點，他並認可團隊以群體感應為基礎的自殺開關生物安全設計。
impact_en: [2023] The team switched its chassis from Pseudoalteromonas luteoviolacea to SAR11, a bacterium corals consume as food, so corals would ingest the bacteria together with the probiotics. His ethics concerns led directly to the Coral Public Awareness Survey, which included questions on public comfort with GMOs.
impact_zh: [2023] 團隊將底盤菌從 Pseudoalteromonas luteoviolacea 改為珊瑚會攝食的 SAR11，讓珊瑚把工程菌連同益生菌一併吃下。他提出的倫理疑慮直接促成「珊瑚公眾認知問卷」，其中納入民眾對 GMO 接受度的題目。

title_zh: 微生物生態學家／研究科學家
expertise_en: Microbial ecology; coral diets and probiotics for reef restoration in aquaculture; aquaculture microbiology and biocontrol
expertise_zh: 微生物生態學；用於珊瑚礁復育的珊瑚飼料與益生菌養殖；水產養殖微生物學與生物防治
summary_en: [2023] In a first online meeting Dr. Høj reviewed the engineered-SAR11 approach, endorsed it, stressed scalability of the robotic delivery system, and proposed metagenomic monitoring of microbiome effects and of coral growth and survival. In a second meeting on the improved design she suggested delivering probiotics as solid coral-feed pellets or a spray (leaning toward the spray for large-scale use), testing the optimal dose, timing applications around stressors such as heat waves, and testing interactions between probiotics and SAR11. For entrepreneurship she also supported the product and its market potential.
summary_zh: [2023] 在第一次線上會議中，Høj 博士審視並肯定團隊的工程 SAR11 方案，強調機器人遞送系統須具可擴展性，並建議以總體基因體分析監測對珊瑚微生物組的影響，以及追蹤珊瑚的生長與存活。第二次會議評估改良設計時，她建議以固態珊瑚飼料顆粒或噴霧遞送益生菌（因大規模應用潛力而較傾向噴霧），並建議測試最適施用量、依熱浪等環境壓力安排施用時程，以及評估不同益生菌與 SAR11 之間的交互作用。在創業面向上，她也支持此產品的開發與市場潛力。
impact_en: [2023] Her input fed into the liquid probiotic spray design, application scheduling for the robot, and planned co-culture tests of probiotics with SAR11; she was cited as a research-market representative in customer discovery and as an expert endorsing the biosafety design.
impact_zh: [2023] 她的建議影響了液態益生菌噴霧設計、機器人施用時程規劃，以及益生菌與 SAR11 共培養測試的規劃；她也在客戶探索中被列為研究端市場代表，並作為認可生物安全設計的專家之一。

expertise_en: Local and international volunteers
expertise_zh: 在地與國際志工
summary_en: [2023] The team hosted a beach cleanup at Shalun Beach with more than 85 volunteers, friends and team members from across Taiwan, collecting a significant amount of garbage and debris. Monica, a visitor from Spain, saw the promotion and joined with her own equipment.
summary_zh: [2023] 團隊在沙崙海灘舉辦淨灘活動，來自全臺的 85 位以上志工、朋友與隊員參與，清出大量垃圾與廢棄物。一位來自西班牙、正在臺灣度假的 Monica 看到活動宣傳，自備工具加入。
impact_en: [2023] Showed that the team's outreach could reach people beyond the local community, and led it to call for a global approach to marine conservation.
impact_zh: [2023] 顯示團隊的推廣能觸及在地社群以外的人，也促使團隊呼籲以全球視野推動海洋保育。

expertise_en: National news and business media
expertise_zh: 全國性新聞與商業媒體
summary_en: [2023] Listed on the iGEM attribution form as a collaborator: a platform for spreading coral-conservation messages to the public and a potential future sponsor. The wiki gives no further details.
summary_zh: [2023] iGEM 貢獻表將其列為合作單位：作為向大眾宣導珊瑚保育的平台，也是潛在的未來贊助者。Wiki 未提供更多細節。

title_zh: 海洋生物專家；CoralWatch 計畫成員
expertise_en: Marine biology; coral health monitoring; coral restoration diving
expertise_zh: 海洋生物學；珊瑚健康監測；珊瑚復育潛水
summary_en: [2023] Jude Lin, a marine biology expert with the CoralWatch project and an experienced coral-restoration diver, joined the team's online meeting arranged through TEIA's Hsuan-Chou Chen. Together they described the state of Taiwan's corals, the public's lack of awareness, and the practical logistics of applying a product underwater.
summary_zh: [2023] Jude Lin 是 CoralWatch 計畫的海洋生物專家，也是經驗豐富的珊瑚復育潛水員，透過台灣環境資訊協會陳玄州先生的安排參與團隊的線上會議，與陳先生一同說明臺灣珊瑚現況、民眾認知不足的問題，以及在水下施用產品的實際後勤考量。
impact_en: [2023] Contributed to the logistics considerations (dive time per oxygen tank, area assessment) behind the spray and hardware design.
impact_zh: [2023] 協助團隊掌握噴霧與硬體設計所需的後勤考量（每支氣瓶的潛水時間、受影響區域評估）。

expertise_en: Climate action; ESG; coral restoration partnerships (with NMMST in Keelung); clean technology promotion
expertise_zh: 氣候行動；ESG；珊瑚復育合作（與基隆海科館）；潔淨技術推廣
summary_en: [2023] The team reached out to Delta Electronics Foundation CEO Wim Chang, since Delta already works on coral restoration and has propagated and transplanted nearly a thousand corals with the ocean museum in Keelung. They discussed the project concept and its future, opening the door to future collaboration. Delta expressed interest in collaborating on the Reef Resilience Service.
summary_zh: [2023] 由於台達已投入珊瑚復育，並與基隆的海洋博物館合作繁殖、移植近千株珊瑚，團隊聯繫台達電子文教基金會執行長張楊乾。雙方討論專案概念與未來發展，為日後合作開啟大門；台達表示有興趣就「珊瑚韌性服務」進行合作。
impact_en: [2023] Delta became the large-corporation customer representative in customer discovery and a potential partner and customer for the Reef Resilience Service's blue-carbon credit model.
impact_zh: [2023] 台達成為客戶探索中的大型企業代表，也是「珊瑚韌性服務」藍碳權模式的潛在合作夥伴與客戶。

expertise_en: Youth climate activism
expertise_zh: 青年氣候行動
summary_en: [2023] Fridays For Future Taiwan took part in the team's beach cleanup and youth video series, and created a collaborative post introducing the team's mission and solution.
summary_zh: [2023] Fridays For Future Taiwan 參與團隊的淨灘活動與青年影片系列，並製作合作貼文介紹團隊的使命與解決方案。

expertise_en: Youth-founded environmental education non-profit
expertise_zh: 青年創立的環境教育非營利組織
summary_en: [2023] Green4Tomorrow took part in the team's beach cleanup and the youth video series, and co-published an Instagram post, 'All About Coral Bleaching'.
summary_zh: [2023] Green4Tomorrow 參與團隊的淨灘活動與青年影片系列，並共同發布 Instagram 貼文〈All About Coral Bleaching〉。

expertise_en: DNA synthesis (gene fragments and primers)
expertise_zh: DNA 合成（基因片段與引子）
summary_en:
[2022] IDT's logo appears in the Sponsors section of the team's Attributions page. The wiki gives no further detail on what was provided.
[2023] IDT synthesised the team's gene fragments and primers, including the MetJ construct, which was synthesised in five fragments, and the biosafety construct.
summary_zh:
[2022] IDT 的標誌列於團隊致謝頁的贊助單位區，維基未進一步說明贊助內容。
[2023] IDT 為團隊合成基因片段與引子，包括分成五段合成的 MetJ 構築體與生物安全構築體。

unit_en: Marine and Aquaculture Sciences (also affiliated with the Australian Institute of Marine Science)
unit_zh: 海洋與水產養殖科學（亦任職於澳洲海洋科學研究所）
expertise_en: Molecular microbial ecology; coral microbiology, pathogens and disease; Beneficial Microorganisms for Corals (BMC)
expertise_zh: 分子微生物生態學；珊瑚微生物、病原與疾病；珊瑚有益微生物（BMC）
summary_en: [2023] The team held an online meeting with Prof. Bourne, whose review introducing 'Beneficial Microorganisms for Corals' was one of the project's main inspirations, to check feasibility. He asked how coral mucus regeneration would affect the application mechanism, how the probiotic strain choice would affect feasibility, and pushed the team to choose a specific target coral species. He also approved the self-destructive biosafety mechanism and supported the product from a research-market perspective.
summary_zh: [2023] 團隊與 Bourne 教授進行線上會議評估可行性；他提出「珊瑚有益微生物」概念的回顧論文是本專案最重要的靈感來源之一。他提出珊瑚黏液再生是否會影響施用機制、益生菌株選擇對可行性的影響等問題，並要求團隊選定特定目標珊瑚物種。他也認可團隊的自殺型生物安全機制，並從研究市場角度支持此產品。
impact_en: [2023] The team chose reef-building corals as its target, confirmed that their mucus turnover leaves enough time for the probiotics and biofilm to integrate into the holobiont, and moved to a more feasible application as a solid coral feed.
impact_zh: [2023] 團隊選定造礁珊瑚為目標，確認其黏液更新速率足以讓益生菌與生物膜整合進珊瑚共生體，並改採較可行的固態珊瑚飼料施用形式。

expertise_en: Youth environmental group
expertise_zh: 青年環境團體
summary_en: [2023] MWCC, a non-profit youth group, took part in the team's beach cleanup and youth video series and published a collaborative post introducing the team.
summary_zh: [2023] 非營利青年團體 MWCC 參與團隊的淨灘活動與青年影片系列，並發布介紹團隊的合作貼文。

unit_en: Institute of Molecular Medicine, College of Medicine
unit_zh: 醫學院 分子醫學研究所
expertise_en: Bacterial genetics; E. coli genome engineering
expertise_zh: 細菌遺傳學；大腸桿菌基因體工程
summary_en: [2023] Dr. Hashimoto provided the materials for the planned csg-operon knockout by homologous recombination: E. coli MG1655 carrying the pKD46 helper plasmid and a plasmid encoding the FLP recombinase to remove the kanamycin-resistance gene.
summary_zh: [2023] 橋本昌征博士提供團隊以同源重組剔除 csg 操縱組所需的材料：帶有 pKD46 輔助質體的大腸桿菌 MG1655，以及用於移除康黴素抗性基因、表現 FLP 重組酶的質體。
impact_en: [2023] Enabled the knockout design; the team did not complete the knockout because of cloning delays.
impact_zh: [2023] 使剔除實驗設計得以進行，但因選殖進度延誤，團隊最終未完成剔除。

organisation_en: National Museum of Marine Science and Technology
expertise_en: Coral conservation and coral diseases; public marine education through BioArt
expertise_zh: 珊瑚保育與珊瑚疾病；以生物藝術（BioArt）進行海洋科普教育
summary_en: [2023] Team members visited NMMST in Keelung and met Dr. Yu-Hung Tsai, who explained current approaches to coral diseases, suggested how to optimise the delivery mechanism, and showed BioArt teaching materials such as crocheted coral hats, coral structures and a crocheted marine ecosystem. The team took part in an environment-themed BioArt exhibition, presented its planned summer-camp materials and asked for advice on effective teaching methods.
summary_zh: [2023] 團隊成員前往基隆的國立海洋科技博物館拜訪蔡博士。他說明目前對抗珊瑚疾病的做法、建議如何優化遞送機制，並展示鉤織珊瑚帽、珊瑚結構與鉤織海洋生態環境等生物藝術教材。團隊也參與了環境主題的生物藝術展，並展示為夏令營準備的教材，請教有效的教學方法。
impact_en: [2023] The visit led to the liquid probiotic spray implementation, and inspired the team to add BioArt to its education plan and the iGEM Syn-Bio Summer Camp.
impact_zh: [2023] 此次參訪促成液態益生菌噴霧的實施方式，並啟發團隊將生物藝術納入教育計畫與 iGEM 合成生物夏令營。

unit_en: Dr. Hsuan-Chen Wu's lab (Lab 106), Department of Biochemical Science and Technology
unit_zh: 生化科技學系 吳亘承老師實驗室（106 室）
expertise_en: Molecular cloning; primer design; lab supervision
expertise_zh: 分子選殖；引子設計；實驗室指導
summary_en: [2023] Listed on the iGEM attribution form as an academic external advisor who designed and checked the team's primers, helped troubleshoot during lab training, assisted with experiments, helped plan lab work and supervised lab activities for safety.
summary_zh: [2023] iGEM 貢獻表將其列為學術界外部顧問：協助設計並檢查引子、在實驗訓練中協助除錯、協助進行實驗與規劃實驗，並監督實驗室安全。

unit_en: Department of Biochemical Science and Technology – Synthetic Biology and Biofabrication Laboratory (Lab 106)
unit_zh: 生化科技學系 合成生物與生物製造實驗室（106 室）
expertise_en: Synthetic biology; metabolic engineering; biofabrication and biomaterials; quorum-sensing switches
expertise_zh: 合成生物學；代謝工程；生物製造與生物材料；群體感應開關
summary_en:
[2022] Dr. Wu, PI of the NTU lab (Lab 106) where the team did its wet-lab work, was one of the first experts the team consulted. In an interview he raised concerns about the target specificity and biocontainment of the chitinase-secreting bacteria, first suggesting ways to adhere the engineered bacteria to the banana root surface, and introduced a toxin-antitoxin approach to keep the bacteria localized in the rhizosphere. He is also credited on the Attributions page for lab support and project advisory.
[2023] The team carried out all its wet-lab work in Dr. Wu's BSL-1 laboratory (Lab 106) at NTU, and consulted him on the cloning cycle and construct design strategy. After repeated failures with PCR and overlap PCR they held a troubleshooting session, where he told them to check the manufacturer's protocols for Q5 polymerase and Gibson Assembly and to redesign all primers. The attribution form also credits him with approving their lab activity and inspiring their quorum-sensing mechanism.
summary_zh:
[2022] 吳亘承副教授是團隊進行濕實驗的臺大實驗室（Lab 106）主持人，也是團隊最早請教的專家之一。訪談中他指出幾丁質酶分泌菌在目標專一性與生物圍堵上的疑慮，最初建議設法讓工程菌附著在香蕉根表面，並提出以毒素－抗毒素系統將菌侷限在根圈。他也列名於致謝頁的實驗室支援與專案顧問。
[2023] 團隊所有濕實驗皆在吳亘承老師位於臺大的生物安全第一等級實驗室（106 室）進行，並向他請教選殖流程與構築體設計策略。在 PCR 與 overlap PCR 多次失敗後，團隊與他進行除錯討論，他建議依照原廠手冊（而非網路上流傳的通用流程）驗證 Q5 聚合酶與 Gibson Assembly 的操作，並重新設計所有引子。貢獻表亦記載他提供實驗室、核准實驗活動，並啟發了團隊的群體感應機制。
impact_en:
[2022] His biocontainment concerns led the team to design a malate-driven CcdA-CcdB toxin-antitoxin kill switch that restricts the bacteria to the banana root rhizosphere, making the biofungicide more sustainable and responsible.
[2023] The team redesigned and reordered its primers, after which the primary construct was successfully transformed into the bacteria.
impact_zh:
[2022] 他對生物圍堵的提醒促使團隊設計以蘋果酸驅動的 CcdA-CcdB 毒素－抗毒素自殺開關，將菌限制在香蕉根圈，使生物殺菌劑更永續、更負責任。
[2023] 團隊重新設計並訂購引子，之後主要構築體成功轉形進入菌株。

unit_en: Dr. Hsuan-Chen Wu's lab (Lab 106), Department of Biochemical Science and Technology
unit_zh: 生化科技學系 吳亘承老師實驗室（106 室）
expertise_en: Engineering-cycle troubleshooting; lab supervision and safety
expertise_zh: 工程循環除錯；實驗室指導與安全
summary_en: [2023] Listed on the iGEM attribution form as an academic external advisor who helped troubleshoot the engineering cycle, gave insight on the project, led the team in the lab and supervised experiments to make sure safety measures were met.
summary_zh: [2023] iGEM 貢獻表將其列為學術界外部顧問：協助工程循環除錯、提供專案建議、在實驗室帶領團隊，並監督實驗以確保符合安全規範。

name_en: Ocean Conservation Administration, Ocean Affairs Council
name_zh: 海洋委員會海洋保育署
organisation_en: Ocean Conservation Administration, Ocean Affairs Council
organisation_zh: 海洋委員會海洋保育署
expertise_en: Marine conservation policy; marine protected areas; coral regulation; marine conservation education
expertise_zh: 海洋保育政策；海洋保護區；珊瑚相關法規；海洋保育教育
summary_en: [2023] The team interviewed the OCA about the ethical and political challenges of implementing the project in Taiwan. The OCA explained the complex legal issues around many coral species, said more data on the product's benefits would be needed for any approval, stressed involving enthusiasts, professionals and the public in conservation, and noted that about 70% of conservation work in Taiwan is outsourced. It also said there are currently no regulations against releasing or using GMO-containing products in the ocean.
summary_zh: [2023] 團隊訪談海洋保育署，了解在臺灣落實專案時的倫理與政策挑戰。海保署說明許多珊瑚物種涉及複雜的法律問題，未來若要取得核准需要更多證明產品效益的數據；並強調應讓愛好者、專業人士與一般民眾共同參與保育，也指出臺灣約七成保育工作為委外執行。海保署亦表示目前沒有法規禁止在海洋中釋放或使用含基因改造生物的產品。
impact_en: [2023] The interview shaped the team's ethics framework and, with Dr. Tang's input, the design of the Coral Public Awareness Survey. The entrepreneurship page states that, given some experimental success, the OCA drafted a potential contract proposal for Taiwan's reef areas, positioning Cure-All Reef as a possible government-contracted service.
impact_zh: [2023] 此次訪談形塑了團隊的倫理框架，並與湯森林老師的建議共同促成珊瑚公眾認知問卷的設計。創業頁面指出，若實驗取得初步成果，海保署已草擬針對臺灣珊瑚礁區的潛在合作提案，顯示本專案具成為政府委託服務的潛力。

expertise_en: Commercial coral farming and coral supply; shallow-water coral harvesting regulations
expertise_zh: 商業珊瑚養殖與供應；淺海珊瑚採集法規
summary_en: [2023] The team visited Panchi Coral Company and learned that protecting shallow-water corals requires fixed harvesting seasons, detailed records and strict inspections. They presented the product concept to get feedback from a large coral company; CEO Yan Qingzhen said the coral spray would be very useful for maintaining its coral farms and a consistent coral supply, and saw strong growth potential for the product across the coral market.
summary_zh: [2023] 團隊參訪 Panchi 珊瑚公司，了解到保護淺海珊瑚須遵守特定採集季節、詳細紀錄與嚴格檢查。團隊向這家大型珊瑚公司介紹產品概念以取得回饋；執行長 Yan Qingzhen 表示珊瑚噴霧對維護其珊瑚養殖場與穩定供貨很有幫助，並認為產品在整個珊瑚市場都有很大的成長潛力。
impact_en: [2023] Panchi served as the coral-farm customer representative in customer discovery for the Reef Resilience Service, helping the team align its business plan with the needs of large coral companies.
impact_zh: [2023] Panchi 在「珊瑚韌性服務」的客戶探索中作為珊瑚養殖業者代表，協助團隊讓商業計畫更貼近大型珊瑚業者的需求。

expertise_en: Youth advocacy for the UN Sustainable Development Goals
expertise_zh: 青年推動聯合國永續發展目標
summary_en: [2023] The team collaborated with SDA17, a group of high school students championing the UN SDGs, and published a series of articles on its website about coral threats, the economic and social effects of coral degradation, co-culture interactions, reef-monitoring software and the benefits of coral probiotics. SDA17 also took part in the team's youth video series.
summary_zh: [2023] 團隊與推動聯合國永續發展目標的高中生團體 SDA17 合作，在其網站發表一系列文章，主題包括珊瑚面臨的威脅、珊瑚退化對經濟與社會的影響、共培養交互作用、珊瑚礁監測軟體以及珊瑚益生菌的好處。SDA17 也參與了團隊的青年影片系列。
impact_en: [2023] Gave the team a platform to reach a broader online audience with coral-conservation content.
impact_zh: [2023] 為團隊提供平台，將珊瑚保育內容推廣給更廣泛的線上讀者。

title_en: Chief Director of Coral Reef Check and Coral Restoration
title_zh: 珊瑚礁體檢與珊瑚復育負責人
expertise_en: Coral reef monitoring (Reef Check) and coral restoration diving in Taiwan; environmental media
expertise_zh: 臺灣珊瑚礁體檢（Reef Check）與珊瑚復育潛水；環境媒體
summary_en: [2023] In an online meeting with TEIA's Hsuan-Chou Chen (and marine biologist Jude Lin), both experienced coral-restoration divers, the team learned about the state of Taiwan's corals and how weak public awareness leads to little government action and funding. On GMO regulation their view matched the OCA's: there are no current restrictions on GMOs in products such as a coral spray. They stressed logistics instead: surveying affected areas, planning dive distribution, and the roughly half-hour limit per oxygen tank.
summary_zh: [2023] 團隊與台灣環境資訊協會的陳玄州先生（及海洋生物專家 Jude Lin）進行線上會議，兩人都是經驗豐富的珊瑚復育潛水員。團隊了解臺灣珊瑚現況，以及公眾認知不足導致政府行動與經費缺乏的困境。關於 GMO 法規，他們的看法與海保署一致：目前沒有限制珊瑚噴霧這類產品使用 GMO 的規定；他們更強調實際施用的後勤問題，包括評估受影響區域、規劃潛水分工，以及每支氣瓶約半小時的作業時間限制。
impact_en: [2023] Their concerns shaped the underwater coral spray's efficiency targets and the hardware designed to reduce reliance on diver labour, and reinforced the motivation for the education program.
impact_zh: [2023] 他們的意見影響了水下珊瑚噴霧的效率設計與降低潛水人力依賴的硬體設計，也強化了團隊推動教育活動的動機。

name_en: The Marine Ecology Art Research Institute
organisation_en: The Marine Ecology Art Research Institute
expertise_en: Integrating marine biology and art; ecological art and BioArt education
expertise_zh: 結合海洋生物學與藝術；生態藝術與生物藝術教育
summary_en: [2023] Because survey respondents preferred learning through BioArt, the team held an online meeting with the institute, whose members share a passion for marine biology and art. They discussed integrating science and art in teaching about corals, current BioArt trends such as ocean-waste recycling, and advice for high schoolers interested in ecological art (join art clubs, set clear goals, use scientific literature). The institute said it welcomes collaborations that bring art into ecological teaching.
summary_zh: [2023] 由於問卷顯示受訪者偏好透過生物藝術學習，團隊與該研究所進行線上會議；其成員同時熱愛海洋生物學與藝術。雙方討論如何在珊瑚教育中融合科學與藝術、以海洋廢棄物回收為主的生物藝術趨勢，以及給對生態藝術有興趣之高中生的建議（加入藝術社團、設定明確目標、善用科學文獻）。該研究所表示歡迎將藝術融入生態教學的合作。
impact_en: [2023] The team learned how to present BioArt in a more engaging way and used it in the BioArt lesson of the iGEM Syn-Bio Summer Camp.
impact_zh: [2023] 團隊學到如何更生動地呈現生物藝術，並運用於 iGEM 合成生物夏令營的生物藝術課程。

expertise_en: Student-run online publication
expertise_zh: 學生經營的線上刊物
summary_en: [2023] The team wrote and published the article 'Cure-All Reefs: A Cure to The Distressing Decline of Coral Reefs' on Student Gaze, a platform popular with high school students from various international schools. The article covered coral decline, the biofilm-based probiotic delivery idea and the quorum-sensing biosafety mechanism.
summary_zh: [2023] 團隊在 Student Gaze 撰寫並發表〈Cure-All Reefs: A Cure to The Distressing Decline of Coral Reefs〉一文。該平台深受多所國際學校高中生歡迎，文章介紹珊瑚衰退問題、以生物膜遞送益生菌的構想，以及群體感應生物安全機制。
impact_en: [2023] Extended the team's reach to a youth audience.
impact_zh: [2023] 將團隊的影響力延伸至青少年讀者。

name_zh: 北卡羅來納大學威爾明頓分校
organisation_zh: 北卡羅來納大學威爾明頓分校
unit_en: Department of Biology and Marine Biology
expertise_en: Coral probiotics; stony coral tissue loss disease (SCTLD); coral pathogens and microbe-microbe antagonism
expertise_zh: 珊瑚益生菌；石珊瑚組織流失症（SCTLD）；珊瑚病原菌與微生物間拮抗機制
city_zh: 北卡羅來納州威爾明頓
summary_en: [2023] After their literature review, the team held an online call with Dr. Ushijima and his team to validate their concept; his paper on a potential probiotic treatment for SCTLD was one of the project's first sources of inspiration. He advised against focusing on a single probiotic, since different coral species under different stresses need different probiotics, and told the team to pick a specific coral and stress type to target.
summary_zh: [2023] 團隊完成文獻回顧後，與 Ushijima 博士及其團隊進行線上會議，驗證專案構想；他關於石珊瑚組織流失症潛在益生菌療法的論文是本專案最早的靈感來源之一。他建議不要只鎖定單一益生菌，因為不同珊瑚物種在不同壓力下需要不同的益生菌，並建議團隊選定特定的珊瑚與壓力類型作為目標。
impact_en: [2023] The design shifted from engineering the probiotics themselves to produce biofilm to a general biofilm-producing carrier bacterium (SAR11) that acts as a temporary, biodegradable glue able to attach any mix of probiotics.
impact_zh: [2023] 設計從「改造益生菌本身產生生物膜」轉為使用通用的生物膜生產菌（SAR11）作為暫時性、可生物分解的黏著劑，可附著任何益生菌組合。

expertise_en: iGEM 2023 high-school team (orchid conservation project)
expertise_zh: iGEM 2023 高中組隊伍（蘭花保育專案）
summary_en: [2023] The WIST iGEM team joined GEMS Taiwan's Shalun Beach cleanup and the youth video series documenting Taiwanese teenagers' environmental efforts.
summary_zh: [2023] WIST iGEM 隊參與 GEMS Taiwan 在沙崙海灘舉辦的淨灘活動，以及記錄臺灣青少年環境行動的青年影片系列。

name_en: iGEM Syn-Bio Summer Camp participants (GEMS Academy)
organisation_en: iGEM Syn-Bio Summer Camp participants (GEMS Academy)
expertise_en: Students interested in synthetic biology and future iGEM participation
expertise_zh: 對合成生物學與未來參加 iGEM 有興趣的學生
summary_en: [2023] The team ran a Synthetic Biology Summer Camp for students interested in synthetic biology and future iGEM teams. It included a BioArt lesson (essence, goals and ethics of BioArt, with iGEM BioArt examples and the iGEM virtual gallery), topic presentations where students chose iGEM tracks and brainstormed projects, and a Model United Nations session debating GMO biosafety and national regulations. Teaching methods were prepared with advice from GEMS Academy educators and NMMST.
summary_zh: [2023] 團隊為對合成生物學與未來參加 iGEM 有興趣的學生舉辦合成生物夏令營，內容包括生物藝術課程（介紹生物藝術的本質、目標與倫理，並展示 iGEM 隊伍的生物藝術案例與 iGEM 線上藝廊）、讓學生選擇 iGEM 賽道並發想專案的主題發表，以及討論 GMO 生物安全與各國法規的模擬聯合國活動。教學方法參考了 GEMS Academy 教師與海科館的建議。
impact_en: [2023] Put the survey finding (38.6% of 303 respondents preferred BioArt) into practice and trained potential future iGEMers.
impact_zh: [2023] 實踐問卷結果（303 位受訪者中 38.6% 偏好生物藝術），並培育未來可能參與 iGEM 的學生。

title_en: Cook; creator of the plant-based food page Chez Jorge
title_zh: 廚師；植物性料理品牌 Chez Jorge 創作者
expertise_en: Plant-based recreations of Taiwanese dishes; food sustainability; meat alternatives
expertise_zh: 以植物性食材重現臺灣料理；食物永續；肉類替代品
summary_en: [2022] George Lee, a Taiwanese cook who recreates Taiwanese dishes with plant-based foods on his food page Chez Jorge, was the guest on episode 4 of the team's podcast That's Bananas!. The conversation covered food sustainability, the environmental effects of meat consumption, and how plant-based foods can be made to taste like meat compared with lab-grown and real meat.
summary_zh: [2022] George Lee 是以植物性食材重現臺灣料理的廚師，經營美食頁面 Chez Jorge，擔任團隊 Podcast《That's Bananas!》第四集來賓。節目討論食物永續、肉食對環境的影響，以及植物性食品如何做出肉的風味，並與實驗室培養肉及真肉比較。
impact_en: [2022] Broadened the podcast beyond the team's project into food sustainability, as the team had planned.
impact_zh: [2022] 使 Podcast 內容如團隊規劃延伸至食物永續議題。

organisation_zh: 杜塞道夫海因里希·海涅大學
summary_en: [2022] Team Düsseldorf submitted its infographic to the infographic translation project; the core team translated it into Mandarin, Norwegian, Thai and Korean for the online exhibition and Instagram.
summary_zh: [2022] Düsseldorf 隊伍提交資訊圖表參與翻譯計畫，核心團隊將其譯為中文、挪威文、泰文與韓文，展示於線上展覽與 Instagram。

unit_en: Students (grades 6–11) at two campuses
unit_zh: 兩校區 6 至 11 年級學生
summary_en: [2022] The team gave in-person presentations to students at two Kang Chiao International School campuses: an interactive Chinese-language session for 7th graders and an advanced English session for 10th graders. On 1 September 2022 it co-organized, with NYCU_Formosa and KCIS_Xiugang_Taipei, an educational panel for about 20 biology-interested students covering BioArt, gel electrophoresis, dry-lab models and the project, ending with a Kahoot game. An animated educational video was also emailed via homeroom teachers to more than 1,500 6th and 8th graders.
summary_zh: [2022] 團隊在康橋國際學校兩個校區進行實體簡報：以中文互動方式向七年級介紹，並以英文進階版向十年級簡報。2022 年 9 月 1 日與 NYCU_Formosa、KCIS_Xiugang_Taipei 共同為約 20 名對生物有興趣的學生舉辦教育活動，內容包括生物藝術、膠體電泳、乾實驗模型與專案介紹，最後以 Kahoot 遊戲收尾。團隊也透過導師將動畫教育影片寄給超過 1,500 名六、八年級學生。
impact_en: [2022] Raised awareness of the banana crisis and synthetic biology among students and encouraged them to join iGEM the following year.
impact_zh: [2022] 提升學生對香蕉危機與合成生物學的認識，並鼓勵他們參加隔年的 iGEM。

organisation_zh: 康橋國際學校（秀岡校區）
expertise_en: High-school synthetic biology outreach
expertise_zh: 高中合成生物學推廣
summary_en: [2022] GEMS_Taiwan coordinated with KCIS_Xiugang_Taipei to host the BioArt event in KCIS's labs together with NYCU_Formosa, educating biology-inclined KCIS students. KCIS_Xiugang_Taipei also sent its infographic to the translation project and distributed GEMS_Taiwan's team introduction in its school newspaper.
summary_zh: [2022] GEMS_Taiwan 與 KCIS_Xiugang_Taipei 協調，並與 NYCU_Formosa 在康橋實驗室共同舉辦生物藝術活動，教育對生物有興趣的康橋學生。KCIS_Xiugang_Taipei 也將資訊圖表交付翻譯計畫，並在校刊刊登 GEMS_Taiwan 的團隊介紹。
impact_en: [2022] Opened a dialogue with biology-inclined students and spread awareness of synthetic biology across the school.
impact_zh: [2022] 建立與對生物有興趣學生的對話，並在全校推廣合成生物學。

organisation_zh: 臺中市私立明道高級中學
summary_en: [2022] Mingdao submitted its infographic to the infographic translation project; the core team translated it into Mandarin, Norwegian, Thai and Korean for the online exhibition and Instagram.
summary_zh: [2022] Mingdao 提交資訊圖表參與翻譯計畫，核心團隊將其譯為中文、挪威文、泰文與韓文，展示於線上展覽與 Instagram。

unit_en: Host of the 2022 Taiwan Synbio Alliance meetup
unit_zh: 2022 臺灣合成生物聯盟交流會主辦
expertise_en: Hosting Taiwan iGEM team meetups
expertise_zh: 主辦臺灣 iGEM 隊伍交流會
summary_en: [2022] On 23 August 2022 the team attended the Taiwan Synbio Alliance meetup held at NCKU and organized by Taiwan's iGEM ambassador. Each team presented its project and progress and received peer-review-style questions and suggestions, followed by a Jamboree-style networking session hosted by team NCKU.
summary_zh: [2022] 2022 年 8 月 23 日，團隊參加由臺灣 iGEM 大使籌辦、在成功大學舉行的臺灣合成生物聯盟交流會。各隊報告專案與進度並接受同儕審查式的提問與建議，之後由 NCKU 隊伍主持類似 Jamboree 的交流活動。
impact_en: [2022] Sharpened the team's presentation and Q&A skills, created new collaboration opportunities (e.g., CCU_Taiwan) and enriched the infographic collection for the translation project.
impact_zh: [2022] 提升團隊簡報與答詢能力，創造新的合作機會（如 CCU_Taiwan），並充實翻譯計畫的資訊圖表收藏。

expertise_en: Cardiovascular disease prevention
expertise_zh: 心血管疾病預防
summary_en: [2022] The teams connected at the Taiwan Synbio Alliance meetup and joined each other's projects. GEMS_Taiwan contributed a braised tofu fish recipe (with fish and tomato for heart health) to CCU_Taiwan's CVD-prevention cookbook, and CCU_Taiwan submitted its infographic to the translation project, among the first to be translated.
summary_zh: [2022] 兩隊在臺灣合成生物聯盟交流會上結識並參與彼此的計畫。GEMS_Taiwan 為 CCU_Taiwan 的心血管疾病預防食譜提供豆腐燒魚食譜（含有益心臟的魚與番茄），CCU_Taiwan 則提交資訊圖表參與翻譯計畫，是最早完成翻譯的隊伍之一。

expertise_en: Chronic wound treatment; Mandarin synthetic-biology video outreach
expertise_zh: 慢性傷口治療；中文合成生物學影片推廣
summary_en: [2022] NCHU_Taichung invited GEMS_Taiwan to its short-video project, a Mandarin YouTube channel introducing Taiwanese iGEM teams to local communities. GEMS_Taiwan submitted a short educational video about its project, which NCHU_Taichung posted on YouTube.
summary_zh: [2022] NCHU_Taichung 邀請 GEMS_Taiwan 參與其短片計畫，透過中文 YouTube 頻道向在地社群介紹臺灣各 iGEM 隊伍。GEMS_Taiwan 提交介紹專案的教育短片，由 NCHU_Taichung 發布於 YouTube。
impact_en: [2022] The video gained several dozen views, adding to the team's awareness-raising efforts in Mandarin.
impact_zh: [2022] 影片獲得數十次觀看，強化團隊以中文推廣議題的成果。

unit_en: Lab 106, Synthetic Biology and Biofabrication Laboratory (Department of Biochemical Science and Technology)
unit_zh: 生化科技學系 合成生物與生物製造實驗室（Lab 106）
expertise_en: Molecular cloning; protein expression; lab safety supervision
expertise_zh: 分子選殖；蛋白質表現；實驗室安全督導
summary_en: [2022] The team's wet-lab work was carried out in Lab 106, a BSL-1 lab run by Prof. Hsuan-Chen Wu, under constant supervision by NTU graduate students and trained lab technicians. The Attributions page credits Yung-Che Tsai, Tzy-Shyuan Hsu, Chi-Ting Sung and Ming-Yan Shen for lab support, and the notebook thanks a lab member (Bryan) for help with transformations.
summary_zh: [2022] 團隊的濕實驗在吳亘承教授主持的生物安全第一等級實驗室 Lab 106 進行，全程由臺大研究生與受訓技術人員督導。致謝頁列出 Yung-Che Tsai、Tzy-Shyuan Hsu、Chi-Ting Sung、Ming-Yan Shen 提供實驗支援，實驗記錄亦感謝 Bryan 協助轉形。
impact_en: [2022] Tips from Lab 106 personnel helped the team devise a thermolysis protein-extraction protocol when sonication/chemical lysis equipment was unavailable; the protocol was later shared as a contribution for future iGEM teams.
impact_zh: [2022] 在缺乏超音波與化學裂解設備的情況下，Lab 106 成員的建議協助團隊發展出熱裂解蛋白萃取流程，後來作為貢獻分享給未來的 iGEM 隊伍。

unit_en: Department of Biochemical Science and Technology
expertise_en: Biochemical science and biotechnology
expertise_zh: 生化科學與生物科技
summary_en: [2022] The NTU Department of Biochemical Science and Technology logo is displayed in the Sponsors section of the team's Attributions page; the team's lab work took place in the department's Lab 106.
summary_zh: [2022] 臺大生化科技學系的系徽列於團隊致謝頁的贊助單位區；團隊的實驗亦在該系 Lab 106 進行。

unit_en: Department of Agronomy, Biometry Division
unit_zh: 農藝學系 生物統計組
expertise_en: Biometry; GMO regulation (former committee member of the Taiwan Council of Agriculture)
expertise_zh: 生物統計；基因改造生物法規（曾任行政院農業委員會委員）
summary_en: [2022] The team interviewed Prof. Liu to refine its implementation and marketing plan and learn the regulations for producing a GMO-based product. Drawing on her time on the Council of Agriculture, she explained that GMO production is prohibited in Taiwan so mass production would have to be abroad, that the COA requires a strict set of tests before GMOs can be commercialized, and discussed pricing given the high cost and long field-testing timeline of GMO products.
summary_zh: [2022] 團隊訪談劉力瑜教授，以精進落地與行銷計畫並了解基改產品生產的相關法規。她以曾任職農委會的經驗說明：臺灣禁止在境內生產基改生物，量產須在國外進行；農委會對基改生物商品化前有嚴格的試驗要求；她也討論了基改產品高昂開發成本與漫長田間試驗對定價的影響。
impact_en: [2022] The team gained a clearer understanding of Taiwan's strict GMO regulations and, on her recommendation, incorporated specific Taiwanese pesticide/biopesticide regulations into its entrepreneurship page.
impact_zh: [2022] 團隊更清楚了解臺灣對基改生物的嚴格規範，並依她的建議將臺灣農藥／生物農藥相關法規納入創業頁面。

organisation_en: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University
expertise_en: BioArt; modeling; wet-lab experimentation
expertise_zh: 生物藝術；建模；濕實驗
summary_en: [2022] NYCU_Formosa hosted an in-person meet-up at its university where the two teams' drylab members discussed modeling techniques and NYCU's wet lab showed GEMS_Taiwan's wet lab around its lab and gave experimental suggestions. NYCU then invited GEMS_Taiwan to its BioArt collaboration, co-hosted with KCIS_Xiugang_Taipei at Kang Chiao International School on 1 September 2022 (BioArt, gel electrophoresis and project introductions for about 20 students). NYCU_Formosa also submitted an infographic for translation.
summary_zh: [2022] NYCU_Formosa 在其校園舉辦實體交流會，兩隊乾實驗成員討論建模技術，NYCU 濕實驗組帶 GEMS_Taiwan 濕實驗組參觀實驗室並提供實驗建議。NYCU 也邀請 GEMS_Taiwan 參與其生物藝術合作，於 2022 年 9 月 1 日與 KCIS_Xiugang_Taipei 在康橋國際學校共同舉辦工作坊（生物藝術、膠體電泳與專案介紹，約 20 名學生參加）。NYCU_Formosa 亦提交資訊圖表供翻譯。
impact_en: [2022] Gave the team modeling and experimentation suggestions and a venue to present its project and synthetic biology to high-school students.
impact_zh: [2022] 為團隊提供建模與實驗建議，並提供向高中生介紹專案與合成生物學的機會。

name_en: Pedestrians at Daan Forest Park and Taipei 101
name_zh: 大安森林公園與台北 101 周邊民眾
organisation_en: Pedestrians at Daan Forest Park and Taipei 101
organisation_zh: 大安森林公園與台北 101 周邊民眾
expertise_en: Middle-aged and older members of the public; banana consumers
expertise_zh: 中高齡民眾；香蕉消費者
summary_en: [2022] To reach middle-aged and older people less comfortable with online surveys, the whole HP team conducted an on-street survey at Da-an Park and Taipei 101, asking passers-by to complete the public survey while explaining the banana crisis. Together with online distribution, the survey collected 1,595 responses.
summary_zh: [2022] 為觸及較不熟悉線上問卷的中高齡族群，人文實踐組全員到大安森林公園與台北 101 進行街頭問卷，邀請路人填答並同時說明香蕉危機。連同線上發放，問卷共回收 1,595 份。
impact_en: [2022] Survey results (84.1% unaware of Fusarium wilt; 67.1% distrusting GM plants) led the team to put more background in its education materials and to protect the plant externally with engineered soil probiotics rather than genetically modifying the banana itself.
impact_zh: [2022] 問卷結果（84.1% 不知道香蕉黃葉病、67.1% 不信任基改植物）促使團隊在教材中加入更多背景說明，並選擇以工程化土壤益生菌從植株外部保護，而非直接改造香蕉。

organisation_zh: 泰國 Ruamrudee 國際學校
expertise_en: Bacterial wilt in crops; bee-venom-derived antimicrobial enzymes
expertise_zh: 作物青枯病；蜂毒來源的抗菌酵素
summary_en: [2022] Because both teams worked on wilt diseases in agriculture, GEMS_Taiwan and Thailand_RIS held multiple meetings exchanging ideas on proteins that disrupt pathogen cell walls/membranes (Thailand_RIS used bee-venom enzymes against bacterial wilt). Thailand_RIS distributed GEMS_Taiwan's public survey in its community, and the two teams co-founded the infographic translation partnership (Thai translations by Thailand_RIS) after recognising the language barrier in their communities. In later meetings they discussed implementation, wet-lab progress and gave feedback on the wiki design.
summary_zh: [2022] 兩隊都處理農業上的萎凋病，因此多次開會交流破壞病原菌細胞壁／膜的蛋白質策略（Thailand_RIS 使用蜂毒酵素對付青枯病）。Thailand_RIS 協助在其社群發放 GEMS_Taiwan 的問卷，兩隊也因察覺各自社群的語言隔閡而共同發起資訊圖表翻譯合作計畫（由 Thailand_RIS 負責泰文翻譯）。後續會議中雙方討論落地方式與濕實驗進度，並互相回饋維基設計。
impact_en: [2022] Thailand_RIS suggested applying the chitinase protein itself to the soil rather than the living GMO, which would greatly reduce regulatory burden and time to market; this became an alternative implementation route on the hardware and safety pages. The survey exchange diversified respondents and sparked the translation partnership.
impact_zh: [2022] Thailand_RIS 建議直接將幾丁質酶蛋白施用於土壤而非施用活的基改菌，可大幅降低法規負擔與上市時間，成為硬體與安全頁中的替代落地方案。問卷交流使受訪者更多元，也催生了翻譯合作計畫。

organisation_zh: 紐約州立大學石溪分校
expertise_en: Protein S deficiency; public science communication (journal archive)
expertise_zh: 蛋白質 S 缺乏症；科學傳播（期刊彙編）
summary_en: [2022] Stony_Brook invited GEMS_Taiwan to its public journal archive project. The Wetlab and HP teams wrote a three-page article explaining banana domestication and disease vulnerability, the people who depend on the banana market, and the team's biochemical solution. Stony_Brook also helped spread GEMS_Taiwan's public survey to its community.
summary_zh: [2022] Stony_Brook 邀請 GEMS_Taiwan 參與其公眾期刊彙編計畫，團隊濕實驗組與人文實踐組撰寫三頁文章，說明香蕉馴化導致的病害脆弱性、依賴香蕉市場的族群，以及團隊的生化解決方案。Stony_Brook 也協助在其社群發放 GEMS_Taiwan 的問卷。
impact_en: [2022] Provided another outreach pathway for raising awareness of Fusarium wilt among the public and future iGEM teams.
impact_zh: [2022] 為向大眾與未來 iGEM 隊伍推廣香蕉黃葉病議題提供另一條管道。

name_zh: 臺北市私立復興實驗高級中學
organisation_zh: 臺北市私立復興實驗高級中學
unit_en: 11th-grade students
summary_en: [2022] The team presented the advanced English version of its educational slides on the banana crisis and its solution to 11th graders at Taipei Fuhsing Private School.
summary_zh: [2022] 團隊以英文進階版教材向復興實驗高中 11 年級學生介紹香蕉危機與團隊的解決方案。
impact_en: [2022] Extended the team's education efforts to a wider range of ages beyond its own school network.
impact_zh: [2022] 將團隊教育推廣擴及更多年齡層與其他學校。

name_zh: 財團法人台灣香蕉研究所
organisation_zh: 財團法人台灣香蕉研究所
expertise_en: Banana cultivation and tissue-culture plantlet production; Fusarium wilt (TR4) and resistant cultivars (GCTCV Tai-Chiao No. 5 and No. 7)
expertise_zh: 香蕉栽培與組織培養種苗生產；香蕉黃葉病（TR4）與抗病品種（台蕉五號、七號）
summary_en: [2022] The team first held an online Google Meet with Mr. Chen, who recommended applying the solution in TBRI's controlled plantlet facilities and at earlier stages of plant life. On 10 August 2022 the team visited TBRI: Mr. Chen presented on banana planting, plantation management and Panama disease, explained the trade-offs of the resistant Tai-Chiao No. 5 and No. 7 cultivars, and toured them through the tissue-culture lab, quarantine screen house, infected fields, the seedling order center and a variety farm. The visit also gave the team access to TBRI's journal archive, which is not available online.
summary_zh: [2022] 團隊先與陳先生進行 Google Meet 線上訪談，他建議將方案應用於香蕉研究所的受控種苗設施，並在植株生命早期施用。2022 年 8 月 10 日團隊實地參訪香蕉研究所：陳先生簡報香蕉種植、蕉園管理與巴拿馬病，說明抗病品種台蕉五號與七號的取捨，並帶領團隊參觀組織培養實驗室、檢疫網室、染病田區、種苗訂購中心與品種園。此行也讓團隊得以查閱網路上無法取得的所內期刊檔案。
impact_en: [2022] The team redirected its solution toward potted plantlets rather than fully grown plants, and built its B2B marketing and implementation plan around selling the inoculant to plantlet producers such as TBRI, whose technicians would inoculate plantlets before distribution to farmers.
impact_zh: [2022] 團隊將方案改為針對盆栽種苗而非成株，並以 B2B 模式規劃行銷與落地：由香蕉研究所等種苗生產單位的技術人員在配送給農民前先為種苗接種。

unit_en: Centre for Horticultural Science
expertise_en: Plant pathology, horticulture and forestry; epidemiology and diversity of Fusarium oxysporum (Panama disease TR4); sustainable banana cultivation
expertise_zh: 植物病理、園藝與林業；尖孢鐮刀菌（巴拿馬病 TR4）流行病學與多樣性；香蕉永續栽培
summary_en: [2022] After reviewing his published work on the epidemiology, infection biology and diversity of F. oxysporum, the team held an online interview with Dr. Drenth to test the viability of its solution. He pointed out that root turnover could let banana roots grow beyond the protective bacterial barrier, leaving new roots exposed to fungal spores in the soil.
summary_zh: [2022] 團隊研讀 Drenth 教授關於尖孢鐮刀菌流行病學、感染生物學與多樣性的論文後，與他進行線上訪談，檢驗解決方案的可行性。他指出「根系更新」（root turnover）可能使香蕉根長出保護性菌層之外，讓新根暴露於土壤中的真菌孢子。
impact_en: [2022] The Wetlab team shifted implementation from field application to inoculation at the nursery/plantlet stage with continued application during vegetative growth; his suggestions (and his published TR4 spread parameters) also shaped Drylab's economic model and the hardware application regimen.
impact_zh: [2022] 濕實驗組因此將應用方式從田間施用改為在育苗／組培苗階段接種，並於營養生長期持續施用；他的建議（以及其發表的 TR4 擴散參數）也影響了乾實驗組的經濟模型與硬體施用排程。

expertise_en: Norwegian translation of iGEM infographics
expertise_zh: iGEM 資訊圖表挪威文翻譯
summary_en: [2022] Recruited by direct message, UiOslo_Norway joined GEMS_Taiwan, Thailand_RIS and Korea_HS as a core member of the infographic translation partnership, translating other teams' infographics into Norwegian and sharing its own infographic. The core teams coordinated through a group chat and online meetings over several months.
summary_zh: [2022] UiOslo_Norway 經私訊邀請，與 GEMS_Taiwan、Thailand_RIS、Korea_HS 共同組成資訊圖表翻譯計畫核心團隊，負責將各隊資訊圖表譯為挪威文，並提供自己的資訊圖表。核心團隊數月間透過群組與線上會議協調。
impact_en: [2022] Allowed the infographic exhibition to reach Norwegian-speaking communities.
impact_zh: [2022] 讓資訊圖表展覽得以觸及挪威語社群。

expertise_en: International Genetically Engineered Machine competition; synthetic biology education
expertise_zh: 國際基因工程機器競賽；合成生物學教育

summary_en: [2022] Korea_HS was the first team GEMS_Taiwan reached out to. In a first meeting the teams exchanged project ideas and Korea_HS distributed GEMS_Taiwan's public survey in Korea; in a second meeting they planned collaborations. GEMS_Taiwan submitted a short video on Fusarium wilt to Korea_HS's Instagram reels project, and Korea_HS joined the core infographic translation team, translating infographics into Korean.
summary_zh: [2022] Korea_HS 是 GEMS_Taiwan 第一個聯繫的隊伍。第一次會議中雙方交流專案構想，Korea_HS 並協助在韓國發放 GEMS_Taiwan 的問卷；第二次會議則規劃合作項目。GEMS_Taiwan 為 Korea_HS 的 Instagram Reels 計畫提交介紹香蕉黃葉病的短片，Korea_HS 則加入資訊圖表核心翻譯團隊，負責韓文翻譯。
impact_en: [2022] Expanded both teams' audiences: GEMS_Taiwan's survey and infographics reached Korean communities, and the first meeting gave the team practice presenting its project for later collaboration meetings.
impact_zh: [2022] 擴大雙方受眾：GEMS_Taiwan 的問卷與資訊圖表觸及韓國社群，第一次會議也讓團隊練習簡報，為後續合作會議做準備。
